coverage.source_unit: First sentence: system shall aim to determine whether driver is in an appropriate position to operate vehicle controls
Second sentence: strategy for classification/detection of positions shall be documented by manufacturer and assessed by TAA

obligations.text: For systems capable of performing system-initiated manoeuvres whilst withholding HORs, the system shall aim to determine whether or not the driver is in an appropriate position to operate the vehicle controls.
obligations.reason: New scoped monitoring requirement for withholding HORs with system-initiated manoeuvres. Candidates o261 (gaze aversion) and o107 (speed strategy) cover different objects; no evidence of continuity.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall document the strategy employed for classification and detection of driver positions (appropriate position to operate the vehicle controls) for systems performing system-initiated manoeuvres whilst withholding HORs, and the Type Approval Authority shall assess it.
obligations.reason: New documentation/assessment obligation for the driver-position strategy; old candidates relate to different strategies (gaze, speed).

coverage.source_unit: Whole clause: if driver deemed not in appropriate position for 10 seconds, an HOR shall be given

obligations.text: For systems performing system-initiated manoeuvres whilst withholding HORs, if the driver is deemed, as per the strategy, not to be in an appropriate position to operate the vehicle controls for 10 seconds, an HOR shall be given.
obligations.reason: New trigger (driver position, 10 s, HOR) in the withholding-HOR context. o269 concerns EOR for visual disengagement at 5 s; different trigger and warning type.

coverage.source_unit: System may continue to perform system-initiated manoeuvres following such an HOR
System shall only resume withholding HORs once driver deemed in appropriate position and not motorically disengaged for at least 30 seconds
Driver shall be informed of the basis for why the system will not resume withholding HORs

obligations.text: Following an HOR given because the driver was not in an appropriate position to operate the vehicle controls for 10 seconds, the system may continue to perform system-initiated manoeuvres.
obligations.reason: New permission in the post-HOR withholding context; o111 and o135 address manoeuvre initiation and rejection differently.

obligations.text: Following such an HOR, the system shall only resume operating while withholding HORs once the driver has been deemed, as per the strategy, to be in an appropriate position to operate the vehicle controls and not to be motorically disengaged for at least 30 seconds.
obligations.reason: New resumption condition for withholding HORs (30 s); no old equivalent. o111 only says motoric disengagement is not considered while withholding.

obligations.text: The driver shall be informed of the basis for why the system will not resume withholding HORs.
obligations.reason: New driver-information requirement; no equivalent in the candidates.

coverage.source_unit: 5.5.4.2.7 heading: Additional Strategies for Disengagement Detection and Re-Engagement Support
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; the requirement text now sits in 5.5.4.2.7.1.

coverage.source_unit: Whole clause: driver state monitoring system shall have strategies to assess driver disengagement when no driver input over prolonged periods, and implement countermeasures

obligations.text: The driver state monitoring system shall have strategies to assess whether the driver is disengaged in the event that no driver input has been determined over prolonged periods (e.g. through a negative determination of driver drowsiness or assessment of changes in gaze direction), and implement appropriate countermeasures.
obligations.reason: Replaces old 5.5.4.2.7 (o283), the same scoped obligation, renumbered to a subparagraph. Substantive change: adds the example 'assessment of changes in gaze direction' and uses 'have' instead of 'be equipped with'.

coverage.source_unit: 5.5.4.2.7.2 intro: during phases where system can perform system-initiated manoeuvres, DSM shall have additional strategies to assess consistent driver engagement, including (a) drowsiness
5.5.4.2.7.2 (b): assess eye gaze changes with appropriate frequency/direction not degrading over time
5.5.4.2.7.2 consequence: if not consistently engaged, no system-initiated manoeuvres other than imminent collision; apply countermeasures
5.5.4.2.7.2 final sentence: strategies documented by manufacturer and assessed by TAA

obligations.text: During phases of operation where the system is able to perform system-initiated manoeuvres, the driver state monitoring system shall have additional strategies to assess behaviours indicating consistent driver engagement with the driving task, including determination of drowsiness.
obligations.reason: New paragraph 5.5.4.2.7.2; no old clause covers drowsiness assessment during system-initiated manoeuvres. Candidates o235, o204, o445 differ in actor/action/scope.

obligations.text: During phases of operation where the system is able to perform system-initiated manoeuvres, the driver state monitoring system shall assess that the driver performs changes in eye gaze with a frequency and/or direction appropriate to the current vehicle traffic environment and upcoming manoeuvres, and that these behaviours do not degrade over time.
obligations.reason: New eye-gaze engagement assessment strategy; no equivalent old clause.

obligations.text: If the driver's behaviours do not indicate consistent engagement with the driving task, system-initiated manoeuvres other than those in situation of imminent collision risk shall not be initiated, and appropriate countermeasures shall be applied as described in the safety concept.
obligations.reason: New restriction on initiating manoeuvres tied to inconsistent engagement; not found in candidates.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall document the strategies implemented to assess behaviours indicating the driver is consistently engaged with the driving task, and these shall be assessed by the Type Approval Authority.
obligations.reason: Documentation/assessment obligation scoped to the new strategies of 5.5.4.2.7.2; o445 is generic Annex 3 documentation, not the same scope.

coverage.source_unit: 5.5.4.2.8 heading: Repeated or Prolonged Driver Disengagement
5.5.4.2.8.1 sentence 1: system disabled for at least 30 minutes whilst powertrain active when driver detected with insufficient engagement
5.5.4.2.8.1 sentence 2: disablement happens once driver has resumed control or vehicle stationary

obligations.text: The system shall be disabled for a period of at least 30 minutes whilst the powertrain is active when the driver is detected to have insufficient engagement.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old o285 (5.5.4.2.8.1, same paragraph number, identical wording, 30 min, powertrain active).

obligations.text: The disablement of the system due to insufficient driver engagement shall happen once the driver has resumed control of the vehicle, or the vehicle has become stationary.
obligations.reason: Sentence is not present in old o285; adds a timing condition for when disablement occurs.

coverage.source_unit: 5.5.4.2.8.2 intro and (a): one unavailability response initiation
5.5.4.2.8.2 (b): at most 2 DCAs due to prolonged insufficient engagement
5.5.4.2.8.2 (c): at most 3 engagement request escalations
5.5.4.2.8.2 (d): one DCA following system-initiated manoeuvre while driver deemed disengaged
5.5.4.2.8.2 (e): at most two DCAs not preceded by escalation and not responded to in less than 5 s
5.5.4.2.8.2 counting reset for (a),(b),(d),(e) when system no longer disabled; (c) rolling 30 min window

obligations.text: The driver shall be deemed to have insufficient engagement when this leads to one unavailability response initiation.
obligations.reason: Same as old o286 (a), same paragraph and scope.

obligations.text: The driver shall be deemed to have insufficient engagement when this leads to at most 2 DCAs due to prolonged insufficient engagement.
obligations.reason: Same as old o286 (b).

obligations.text: The driver shall be deemed to have insufficient engagement when this leads to at most 3 engagement request escalations.
obligations.reason: Same as old o286 (c).

obligations.text: The driver shall be deemed to have insufficient engagement when this leads to one DCA following a system-initiated manoeuvre performed when the driver is deemed to be disengaged (as per paragraph 5.3.7.2.4.10.).
obligations.reason: Criterion (d) is added; not in old o286.

obligations.text: The driver shall be deemed to have insufficient engagement when this leads to at most two DCAs which were not preceded by an escalation and not responded to in less than 5 seconds.
obligations.reason: Criterion (e) is added; not in old o286.

obligations.text: For criteria (a), (b), (d) and (e), counting is reset when the system is no longer disabled. For criterion (c), the count is determined over a rolling time window of 30 minutes during the activation of the powertrain.
obligations.reason: Counting rules continue from old o286 but reset now also covers new (d) and (e).

coverage.source_unit: 5.5.4.2.8.3 sentence 1: driver deemed insufficiently engaged if repeated EOR or HOR due to disengagement within a time period
5.5.4.2.8.3 sentence 2: manufacturer defines number of warnings and time interval and justifies to TAA

obligations.text: The driver shall also be deemed to have insufficient engagement if there are repeated EOR or HOR due to driver disengagement within a given time period.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o287 (5.5.4.2.8.3).

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall define the number of warnings and the time interval over which repeated EOR or HOR are counted, and justify them to the Type Approval Authority.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o287 second sentence.

coverage.source_unit: 5.5.4.2.8.4: when disabled due to insufficient engagement, system only re-enabled after driver deliberate confirmation of understanding of responsibilities and appropriate use

obligations.text: When the system is disabled due to insufficient engagement by the driver, the system shall only be re-enabled after the driver has confirmed by a deliberate action their understanding of their responsibilities and appropriate use of the system.
obligations.reason: Replaces old o288 in the same paragraph 5.5.4.2.8.4 (same trigger: disabled due to insufficient engagement); the requirement to request the driver read information material is replaced by a deliberate-confirmation re-enable condition.

coverage.source_unit: 5.6 para 1: manufacturer shall provide clear, accessible, free-of-charge information on system operation on specific vehicle type in addition to user manual
5.6 items (a)-(j)(vii): minimum content list, non-technical terminology
5.6 last para: shall not mislead about capabilities, limits or level of automation
6 para 1: manufacturer shall demonstrate fulfilment to Type Approval Authority during safety approach inspection (Annex 3) and Annex 4 tests
6 para 2: system shall fulfil paragraph 6 requirements where applicable, within boundary conditions per 5.3.5.2
heading 5.6 Driver Information Materials

obligations.text: In addition to the user manual, the manufacturer shall provide clear and easily accessible information (e.g. documentation, video, website materials) free of charge regarding system operation on the specific vehicle type.
obligations.reason: Same obligation as o289 (5.6, same paragraph number, identical wording and scope).

obligations.text: The driver information shall cover at least: (a) driver's responsibilities and appropriate use; (b) how and to what extent the system assists; (c) capabilities and limitations; (d) System Boundaries; (e) modes of operation and transitions; (f) mode transition to other assistance/automated systems, if applicable; (g) Driver Disengagement Detection; (h) Privacy Management; (i) how to override the system or features; (j) HMI: activation/deactivation, status indication, messages and signals and their interpretation, behaviour when reaching and when exceeding system boundaries, information on system failures, and mode transition to other systems if applicable; using terminology understandable by a non-technical audience.
obligations.reason: Same content list as o289 in 5.6; unchanged.

obligations.text: In the manufacturer's documentation, including educational materials (e.g. documentation, video, website materials) addressed to consumers, the manufacturer shall not describe the system in a manner that would mislead the customer about the capabilities and limits of the system or about its level of automation.
obligations.reason: Same prohibition as o289 in 5.6; unchanged.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall demonstrate the fulfilment of the provisions of paragraph 6 to the Type Approval Authority during the inspection of the safety approach as part of the assessment to Annex 3 and according to the relevant tests in Annex 4.
obligations.reason: Same demonstration obligation present in o289 (paragraph 6 intro text); unchanged.

obligations.text: The system shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 6 where applicable to the design of the system and relevant to the safety concept, when operated within its boundary conditions according to paragraphs 5.3.5.2.
obligations.reason: Same requirement present in o289 (paragraph 6 intro text); unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.1 heading: Specific requirements for positioning in the lane of travel
6.1.1 heading: Increased lateral dynamics
6.1.1.1 main: for M1/N1, feature may induce lateral acceleration above 3 m/s² provided conditions (a)-(e) are met
6.1.1.1 final sentence: when any condition no longer met, system shall implement strategies to ensure controllability

obligations.text: Notwithstanding 5.3.7.1.2., for M1 and N1 vehicles the feature may be permitted to induce lateral acceleration higher than 3 m/s² (e.g. to not disturb traffic flow), provided all of: (a) system provides visual information to the driver on the upcoming or ongoing situation that may induce higher lateral acceleration; (b) no disengagement warning is being given; (c) system operation remains predictable and controllable per 5.3.6.; (d) vehicle is travelling at the system-determined road speed limit or below; (e) driver is not determined to be motorically disengaged.
obligations.reason: Matches o292 (6.1.1.1) with identical scope, conditions and values; only pagination differs.

obligations.text: When any of the conditions (a)-(e) for permitting lateral acceleration above 3 m/s² are no longer met, the system shall implement strategies to ensure controllability.
obligations.reason: Matches final sentence of o292; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.1.1.2: manufacturer shall demonstrate to TAA how 6.1.1.1 is implemented in system design

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall demonstrate to the Type Approval Authority how the provisions of paragraph 6.1.1.1. (higher lateral acceleration conditions) are implemented in the system design.
obligations.reason: Identical to o293 (6.1.1.2), same scope referencing 6.1.1.1; o311 relates to 6.2.4 and is a different obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 6.1.2 heading: Merging roads and slip roads on highways

6.1.2.1 first sentence: if system can assist in merging roads, aim to detect lane-merge situations (incl. slip roads) and be designed to ensure safe control accounting for road users in neighbouring lane
6.1.2.1 second sentence: if system handles such situation by manoeuvre, it shall comply with the regulation

obligations.text: If the system has the capability to assist in merging roads, it shall aim to detect situations where the current lane of travel merges into another lane of travel (including slip roads), and shall be designed to ensure safe control in these situations accounting for road users in the neighbouring lane.
obligations.reason: Relocated/renumbered paragraph with identical scope to old clause o295 (same paragraph number 6.1.2.1 under 6.1.2 Merging roads); actor, action and conditions unchanged.

obligations.text: If the system is designed to handle a lane-merging situation (current lane merging into another lane, including slip roads) by performing a manoeuvre, the manoeuvre shall be in accordance with the provisions of this regulation.
obligations.reason: Same conditional manoeuvre-compliance requirement as the second sentence of old o295 in the same merging-roads context; no substantive change.

coverage.source_unit: 6.1.3 heading: Leaving the lane to form an access corridor for emergency and enforcement vehicles
6.1.3.1: if capable of forming access corridor, only leave current lane to (pre-emptively) form it where required and allowed by national traffic rules

obligations.text: If the system is capable of forming an access corridor for emergency and enforcement vehicles, the system shall only leave its current lane of travel to (pre-emptively) form an access corridor where this is required and allowed according to national traffic rules.
obligations.reason: Identical scope and conditions to old o297 (6.1.3.1) under the same access-corridor heading; no change.

coverage.source_unit: 6.1.3.2: while forming access corridor, ensure sufficient lateral and longitudinal distance to road boundaries, vehicles and other road users

obligations.text: While forming an access corridor, the system shall ensure sufficient lateral and longitudinal distance to road boundaries, vehicles and other road users.
obligations.reason: Same scoped requirement as old o298 (6.1.3.2) in the access-corridor context; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.1.3.3: vehicle shall return completely to original lane once situation requiring access corridor has passed

obligations.text: The vehicle shall return completely to its original lane of travel once the situation that required the access corridor to be formed has passed.
obligations.reason: Same requirement as old o299 (6.1.3.3) within the access-corridor section; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.1.4 heading: Lane positioning on roads without lane marking
6.1.4.1 whole sentence: systems designed to perform lane positioning on roads without lane markings shall use other sources of information to robustly determine and pursue the trajectory

obligations.text: If the system is designed to perform lane positioning on roads without lane markings, it shall utilize other sources of information in order to robustly determine and pursue the appropriate trajectory in respect of other road users.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old 6.1.4.1 (o301): identical actor, condition and action, same paragraph number; only the page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2 heading: Specific Requirements for lane changes
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; it imposes no obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.1 whole sentence: a lane change only if the system has sufficient information about its surroundings (front, side, rear) to assess criticality

obligations.text: A lane change shall only be performed if the system has sufficient information about its surrounding to the front, side and rear in order to assess the criticality of that lane change.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old 6.2.1 (o303): identical wording, same paragraph number and same lane-change context.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.2 whole sentence: no lane change toward a lane intended for opposite-direction traffic

obligations.text: A lane change shall not be performed towards a lane intended for traffic moving in the opposite direction.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old 6.2.2 (o304): identical wording and context, same paragraph number.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.3 first sentence, additional lateral acceleration: design to avoid more than 1.5 m/s² in addition to the curvature-generated acceleration during a lane change
6.2.3 first sentence, total lateral acceleration: design to avoid a total lateral acceleration above 3.5 m/s² during a lane change
6.2.3 second sentence: 0.5 s moving average of system-generated lateral jerk shall not exceed 5 m/s³

obligations.text: During the lane change manoeuvre, the system shall be designed to avoid a lateral acceleration of more than 1.5 m/s² in addition to the lateral acceleration generated by the lane curvature.
obligations.reason: Same scoped limit as old 6.2.3 (o305): same wording, value and lane-change scope.

obligations.text: During the lane change manoeuvre, the system shall be designed to avoid a total lateral acceleration in excess of 3.5 m/s².
obligations.reason: Same scoped limit as old 6.2.3 (o305): same value and lane-change scope.

obligations.text: During the lane change manoeuvre, the moving average over half a second of the lateral jerk generated by the system shall not exceed 5 m/s3.
obligations.reason: Same sentence as in old 6.2.3 (o305), applied to the lane-change manoeuvre. The similar generic 5.3.7.1.2.1 (o106) is a separate lane-positioning requirement.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.4 whole sentence: start a lane change only if a vehicle in the target lane is not forced to unmanageably decelerate

obligations.text: A lane change manoeuvre shall only be started if a vehicle in the target lane is not forced to unmanageably decelerate due to the lane change of the vehicle.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old 6.2.4 (o306): identical wording and context, same paragraph number.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.4.1 first paragraph: system designed not to make approaching vehicle decelerate above 3.0 m/s² (distance never less than 1 s of DCAS travel)
6.2.4.1 assessment assumptions (a) 1.4 s after lateral movement start, and (b)(i)/(ii) alternatives
6.2.4.1 final paragraph: speeds up to 60 km/h permitted deviation (permission)
6.2.4.1 final paragraph: manufacturer explanation and evidence for deviation cases
6.2.4.1 heading 'When there is an approaching vehicle.'
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading/applicability label only; scope carried into obligations

obligations.text: When there is an approaching vehicle in the target lane, the system shall be designed to not make the approaching vehicle decelerate at a higher level than 3.0 m/s², so that the distance between the two vehicles is never less than that which the DCAS vehicle travels in 1 second.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old 6.2.4.1 first paragraph; same paragraph number, wording and values, only page changed.

obligations.text: The 6.2.4.1 assessment shall assume the approaching vehicle begins deceleration (a) 1.4 s after the system starts the lateral movement of the lane change procedure; and (b) either (i) 0.4 s after the system starts the lane change manoeuvre, provided the approaching vehicle was detected by the DCAS vehicle for at least 1.0 s immediately before the manoeuvre starts, or (ii) 1.4 s after the system starts the lane change manoeuvre.
obligations.reason: Matches old o307 assessment assumptions with identical timings and conditions; renumbering/page shift only.

obligations.text: At speeds up to 60 km/h the system may deviate from the 6.2.4.1 assessment (approaching-vehicle deceleration assessment).
obligations.reason: Sentence not in old o307, which ended at (b)(ii); new permission for speeds up to 60 km/h.

obligations.text: Where the system deviates from the 6.2.4.1 assessment at speeds up to 60 km/h, the manufacturer shall explain to the Type Approval Authority the distances and timings for an approaching vehicle under which a lane change manoeuvre can be started, and provide evidence that those situations are deemed controllable for other road users.
obligations.reason: New manufacturer explanation/evidence obligation absent from old o307; Annex 3 3.4.1 is a general safety concept statement, not equivalent.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.4.2 intro and (a)-(c): assessment per 6.2.4.1 when no approaching vehicle detected, with assumptions
6.2.4.2 final sentence: target lane just commenced deemed fulfilled if no vehicle detected to rear
6.2.4.2 heading

obligations.text: If no approaching vehicle is detected by the system in the target lane, the assessment shall be calculated as per paragraph 6.2.4.1 assuming: (a) the approaching vehicle is at a distance equal to the actual rearward detection range; (b) it travels at the allowed maximum speed or 130 km/h, whichever is lower; and (c) its full width is detected by the system during lateral movement for at least 1 second.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o308 (similarity 1.0), same scope and values.

obligations.text: When the target lane has just commenced, the 6.2.4.2 requirement is deemed fulfilled if no vehicle is detected along the length of the target lane to the rear.
obligations.reason: Same deeming provision as old o308 final sentence, unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.4.3: system-intended deceleration during lane change factored into assessment of distance to rear approaching vehicle
6.2.4.3: deceleration shall not exceed 2 m/s² except to avoid/mitigate imminent collision

obligations.text: If the system intends to decelerate the vehicle during a lane change procedure, this deceleration shall be factored in when assessing the distance to a vehicle approaching from the rear.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o309 first part.

obligations.text: The system's deceleration during a lane change procedure shall not exceed 2 m/s², except for the purpose of avoiding or mitigating the risk of an imminent collision.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o309 limit and exception.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.4.4: no increase of deceleration for at least 2 s after lane change completion where headway insufficient, with exceptions

obligations.text: Where there is not sufficient headway time for the vehicle behind at the end of the lane change procedure, the system shall not increase the rate of deceleration for at least 2 seconds after completion of the lane change procedure, except where necessary for nominal operation of the system (e.g., responding to road infrastructure or other road users) or avoiding or mitigating the risk of an imminent collision.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o310, same scope, value and exceptions.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.5: manufacturer demonstrates implementation of 6.2.4 in system design to TAA

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall demonstrate to the Type Approval Authority how the provisions of paragraph 6.2.4 are implemented in the system design.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o311 with same reference to 6.2.4; o293 relates to 6.1.1.1 so is a different scope.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.6 first sentence: system generates direction indicator activation signal unless already activated by driver
6.2.6 second sentence: indicator remains active throughout lane change procedure
6.2.6 second sentence: system deactivates indicator in timely manner once positioning feature resumed unless control latched

obligations.text: The system shall generate a signal to activate the direction indicator for a lane change procedure unless it is already activated by the driver.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o312 first sentence.

obligations.text: The direction indicator signal shall remain active throughout the whole period of the lane change procedure.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o312 second sentence part.

obligations.text: The system shall deactivate the direction indicator signal in a timely manner once the positioning in the lane of travel feature is resumed, unless the direction indicator control remains fully engaged (latched position).
obligations.reason: Identical to old o312 deactivation requirement and exception.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.7 first sentence: lane change procedure indicated to other road users at least 3 s before start of lane change manoeuvre
6.2.7 second sentence: shorter indication time permitted where not in violation of national traffic rules and sufficient notice still given

obligations.text: A lane change procedure shall be indicated to other road users for at least 3 seconds prior to the start of the lane change manoeuvre.
obligations.reason: Identical scoped obligation relocated from old 6.2.7 (o313) under the same parent 6.2 lane change requirements; no substantive change.

obligations.text: A shorter lane change indication time than 3 seconds is permitted where this is not in violation of national traffic rules in the country of operation, and sufficient notice of the manoeuvre is nevertheless given to other road users.
obligations.reason: Same permission/exception as in old 6.2.7 (o313), unchanged wording and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.8 whole paragraph: when lane change procedure suppressed, inform driver with optical signal plus acoustic or haptic signal

obligations.text: When the lane change procedure is suppressed by the system, it shall clearly inform the driver by means of an optical signal in combination with either an acoustic or haptic signal.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 6.2.8 (o314), same actor, condition and signal requirement.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.9 heading: Additional requirements for lane changes
6.2.9.1 heading: Additional requirements for driver-confirmed lane changes
6.2.9.1.1 first sentence: system shall aim not to make approaching vehicle in target lane unreasonably decelerate, particularly when lane change not urgent
6.2.9.1.1 second sentence: where decelerating another vehicle is necessary due to traffic situation, 6.2.4.1 requirements apply
6.2.9.1.1 second paragraph: lane change procedure only proposed if sufficient free space available or reasonably expected, allowing LCM per 6.2.4

obligations.text: For driver-confirmed lane changes, the system shall aim not to make an approaching vehicle in the target lane unreasonably decelerate, particularly where the lane change is not urgent (e.g., overtaking a slower moving vehicle).
obligations.reason: Identical to old 6.2.9.1.1 (o317) under the same driver-confirmed lane change heading.

obligations.text: For driver-confirmed lane changes, where making another vehicle in the target lane decelerate is necessary due to the traffic situation (e.g., current lane ending, dense traffic in the target lane), the requirements of paragraph 6.2.4.1 shall apply.
obligations.reason: Same conditional obligation as old 6.2.9.1.1 (o317), unchanged.

obligations.text: For driver-confirmed lane changes, a lane change procedure shall only be proposed if sufficient free space in the target lane is already available or can reasonably be expected to become available, allowing a LCM to be executed according to paragraph 6.2.4.
obligations.reason: Same sentence and scope as old 6.2.9.1.1 (o317), unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.9.1.2 whole paragraph: notwithstanding 6.2.4.2(b), approaching vehicle assumed at allowed max speed +10% or 130 km/h, whichever lower

obligations.text: For driver-confirmed lane changes, notwithstanding paragraph 6.2.4.2 (b), the approaching vehicle in the target lane shall be assumed to be travelling at the allowed maximum speed + 10% or 130 km/h, whichever is lower.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 6.2.9.1.2 (o318) with same driver-confirmed scope.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.9.2 heading: Additional requirements for system-initiated lane changes
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; imposes no requirement itself.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.9.2.1 whole sentence: requirements of 6.2.9.1 apply equally to system-initiated lane changes

obligations.text: For system-initiated lane changes, the requirements outlined in paragraph 6.2.9.1 (driver-confirmed lane changes) shall equally apply.
obligations.reason: Same scoped cross-reference obligation renumbered only by page; old clause o320 (6.2.9.2.1) has identical wording and scope under system-initiated lane changes.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.9.2.2 whole sentence: aim to detect restricted lanes and aim to refrain from initiating lane changes to them (system-initiated lane changes)

obligations.text: For system-initiated lane changes, the system shall aim to detect restricted lanes of travel which restrict access to specific vehicle road users (e.g., bus, bike or taxi lanes) and shall aim to refrain from initiating lane changes to such lanes.
obligations.reason: Identical obligation in old clause o321 (6.2.9.2.2) with same actor, action and scope; only the page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.9.3 heading
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading/title describing applicability; the condition is carried into the obligations.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.9.3 first sentence: if designed to assist lane changes on roads without physical separation, implement strategies so target lane is not designated for oncoming traffic
6.2.9.3 second sentence: strategies demonstrated to and assessed by Technical Service per Annex 4 tests during Type Approval

obligations.text: If the system is designed to assist lane changes on roads where there is no physical separation of traffic moving in opposite directions, the system shall implement strategies to ensure that the lane change procedure is only performed into or via a lane where the target lane is not designated for oncoming traffic.
obligations.reason: Same obligation as old clause o322 (6.2.9.3), unchanged wording and scope.

obligations.text: For systems designed to assist lane changes on roads without physical separation of opposing traffic, the strategies preventing lane changes into or via a lane designated for oncoming traffic shall be demonstrated to and assessed by the Technical Service according to the corresponding tests in Annex 4 during Type Approval.
obligations.reason: Same demonstration/assessment obligation as in old clause o322 (6.2.9.3); unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.9.4 heading
6.2.9.4 sentence: lane change on roads with pedestrians and cyclists only permitted if system can avoid risk of collision with any vulnerable road user

obligations.text: On roads where pedestrians and/or bicycles are not prohibited, the system shall only be permitted to perform a lane change if it is able to avoid causing risk of a collision with any vulnerable road user (such as pedestrians and cyclists).
obligations.reason: Identical to old clause o323 (6.2.9.4) in actor, condition and restriction.

coverage.source_unit: 6.2.9.5 heading
6.2.9.5 sentence: time between initiation and start of lane change manoeuvre only extended beyond 7 s if not violating national traffic rules

obligations.text: The time between initiation of the lane change procedure and start of the lane change manoeuvre shall only be extended beyond 7 seconds where this is not in violation of national traffic rules.
obligations.reason: Same obligation as old clause o324 (6.2.9.5); wording and values unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3 heading: Specific requirements for other manoeuvres other than a lane change
6.3.1 intro and (a)-(f): scope of manoeuvres to which paragraph 6.3 provisions apply

obligations.text: The provisions of paragraph 6.3.1 apply to manoeuvres which lead the vehicle to: (a) select a lane where the manoeuvre is neither following the current lane of travel nor a lane change; or (b) navigate a roundabout by entering, navigating and exiting; or (c) navigate around an obstruction in the lane of travel; or (d) provide sufficient lateral distance to safely pass an object adjacent to the lane of travel (e.g., a cyclist in a cycle lane); or (e) take a turn (e.g., at an intersection); or (f) depart or arrive at a parked position.
obligations.reason: Same scoping provision, renumbered/relocated unchanged from o326 (6.3.1) with identical scope and list (a)-(f); only page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3.2 whole paragraph: response to vehicles, road users, infrastructure or blocked path

obligations.text: For manoeuvres other than a lane change, the system shall be designed to respond to vehicles, road users, infrastructure or a blocked path ahead which are already within or may enter the planned trajectory or the corresponding driving environment in order to ensure safe operation.
obligations.reason: Identical to o327 (6.3.2) with the same actor, object and scope; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3.3 whole paragraph: respond to traffic lights, stop signs, right-of-way infrastructure and restricted lanes

obligations.text: For manoeuvres other than a lane change, the system shall be designed to respond to traffic lights, stop signs, right-of-way infrastructure (such as zebra crossings or bus stops) and restricted lanes appropriate to the system's given lane of travel, or the lane of travel the system would find itself in as a result of the manoeuvre, where deemed relevant for the given manoeuvre and operating domain (e.g., highway or non-highway).
obligations.reason: Identical to o328 (6.3.3), same scope and conditions; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3.4 whole paragraph: navigate hillcrests

obligations.text: For manoeuvres other than a lane change, the system shall be designed to safely and cautiously navigate hillcrests where this is deemed relevant for the controllability of the given manoeuvre.
obligations.reason: Identical to o329 (6.3.4), same scope; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3.5 whole paragraph: respond to vulnerable road users crossing the lane of travel

obligations.text: If the manoeuvre would potentially lead the system to cross paths with vulnerable road users crossing the lane of travel (e.g., bike path, crosswalk), the system shall be designed to respond appropriately to the road users and infrastructure.
obligations.reason: Identical to o330 (6.3.5), same condition and action; unchanged, only page span differs.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3.6 whole sentence: if manoeuvre leads to crossing paths with crossing traffic or merging with traffic from a different direction, system designed to respond appropriately (e.g., give way)

obligations.text: If a manoeuvre would lead the system to cross paths with crossing traffic (e.g., when taking a turn) or to merge with traffic approaching from a different direction, the system shall be designed to respond appropriately to these road users (e.g., by giving way).
obligations.reason: Identical wording and scope to old clause o331 (6.3.6, same parent 6.3), renumbered page only; no substantive change.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3.7 first sentence: where relevant, system designed to detect restricted lanes and aim to refrain from navigating on them
6.3.7 second sentence: upon detecting entry into restricted lane, propose or perform lane change to appropriate lane, or request driver to resume manual control

obligations.text: Where relevant to the manoeuvre, the system shall be designed to detect restricted lanes of travel (e.g., bus, bike or taxi lanes) and shall aim to refrain from navigating on such lanes.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old o332 (6.3.7), identical wording and parent 6.3.

obligations.text: In the event the system detects that it has entered into a restricted lane of travel, it shall propose or perform a lane change procedure to an appropriate lane of travel as appropriate to the system design, or request the driver to resume manual control.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old o332 (6.3.7), identical wording and parent 6.3.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3.8 whole sentence: system shall aim to respect appropriate right-of-way rules

obligations.text: The system shall aim to respect appropriate right-of-way rules.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o333 (6.3.8) under same parent 6.3; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3.9 heading: Additional Requirements for navigating around an obstruction in the lane of travel
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading introducing subparagraphs 6.3.9.1 and 6.3.9.2; no standalone obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3.9.1 (a)-(c) list: circumstances under which navigating around an obstruction can be performed (stationary obstacle; very slow-moving vehicle/road user with sufficient lateral distance; instructed by legitimate external sources if applicable to design)

6.3.9.1 final sentence: other reasons to cross into another lane may be accepted if manufacturer presents sufficient information to the Type Approval Authority and it is determined appropriate and safe

obligations.text: Navigating around an obstruction can be performed only under these circumstances: (a) driving around a stationary obstacle (e.g., parked vehicle, debris) in the lane; (b) passing a very slow-moving vehicle or road user with sufficient lateral distance; (c) the manoeuvre is instructed by legitimate external sources (e.g., static and dynamic road signs, road works, emergency or enforcement instruction), if applicable to the system's design.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o335 (6.3.9.1) with the same parent 6.3.9; unchanged.

obligations.text: Other reasons to cross into another lane may be accepted if the manufacturer presents sufficient information to the Type Approval Authority and it is determined that it is appropriate and the system would be able to safely operate.
obligations.reason: Identical to the final sentence of old o335 (6.3.9.1); unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3.9.2 whole sentence: navigating around an obstruction only permitted if system can determine position and movement of road users front, side, rear where relevant and adequate distance exists

obligations.text: Navigating around an obstruction shall only be permitted if the system is able to determine the position and movement of other road users to the front, side and rear where relevant to the specific manoeuvre, and that there is adequate distance to them to perform the manoeuvre.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o336 (6.3.9.2) under same parent 6.3.9; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3.9.3 first sentence: cross into another lane only if sufficient space and time confirmed, no oncoming road users impeding reverting
6.3.9.3 third sentence: shall not cross into opposite-direction lane to pass general traffic at appropriate speed
6.3.9.3 last sentence: indicate the manoeuvre to other road users throughout

obligations.text: If a manoeuvre around an obstruction would cause the vehicle to cross partially or fully into another lane, the system shall only do so if it is able to confirm that sufficient space and time is available, such that there are no oncoming road users which would impede the system from completing the manoeuvre by reverting to the appropriate lane of travel.
obligations.reason: Same paragraph number 6.3.9.3 under same parent 6.3.9, identical wording and scope as o337 (similarity 1.0).

obligations.text: When navigating around an obstruction, the system shall not cross into another lane where the direction of travel is opposite, to pass general traffic moving at an appropriate speed.
obligations.reason: Continuation of o337 6.3.9.3, same scope and wording, unchanged.

obligations.text: The system shall appropriately indicate the manoeuvre around an obstruction to other road users throughout the manoeuvre.
obligations.reason: Same final sentence in o337 6.3.9.3, unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3.9.4 whole paragraph: no suggesting or performing manoeuvre crossing non-permitted solid lane marking unless permitted per 6.3.9.1(c)

obligations.text: The system shall not suggest a manoeuvre to the driver or perform a system-initiated manoeuvre which intends to cross a solid lane marking that is not permitted to be crossed, unless permitted by the situation described in paragraph 6.3.9.1(c).
obligations.reason: Identical to o338 6.3.9.4 under same parent 6.3.9; same actor, action and exception.

coverage.source_unit: 6.4 heading: scope of additional requirements for non-highway system-initiated manoeuvres
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading/applicability statement only; no independent obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 6.4.1 whole paragraph: 6.3.2-6.3.8 apply when going straight across intersection for systems capable of system-initiated turns

obligations.text: For systems capable of performing a system-initiated left or right turn at an intersection, the provisions of paragraphs 6.3.2 to 6.3.8 shall equally apply when going straight across that intersection.
obligations.reason: New paragraph extending 6.3.2-6.3.8 to straight-across-intersection case; no old clause establishes this scoped extension (candidates o147, o733 concern different scope).

coverage.source_unit: 6.4.2 intro and (a): drive-off only if driver not visually disengaged >2 s prior
6.4.2 (b): drive-off only if no collision risk confirmed along drive-off path
7. Monitoring of DCAS operation (following heading)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading of next section, not an obligation.

obligations.text: In non-highway environments, the system shall only make the vehicle automatically accelerate from standstill if, at the moment of drive off, the driver is not deemed to be visually disengaged as per paragraph 5.5.4.2.5 for more than 2 seconds immediately prior to the drive off.
obligations.reason: No old clause covers automatic drive-off conditions in non-highway environments; candidates concern headway, lane-change deceleration and HOR withholding.

obligations.text: In non-highway environments, the system shall only make the vehicle automatically accelerate from standstill if, at the moment of drive off, the system has confirmed there is no risk of collision detected along the drive-off path.
obligations.reason: New separate drive-off condition for non-highway environments; no equivalent old clause.

coverage.source_unit: 7.1 heading: Monitoring of DCAS Operation
7.1.1 – manufacturer shall maintain processes to monitor safety-critical occurrences caused by operation of the system

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall maintain processes to monitor safety-critical occurrences caused by the operation of the system.
obligations.reason: Same actor, action and object as old 7.1.1 under the same 7.1 Monitoring of DCAS Operation heading; the text is unchanged and only the page differs.

coverage.source_unit: 7.1.2 – manufacturer shall set up a monitoring program to collect and analyse data providing evidence of in-service safety performance and confirmatory evidence of Annex 3 SMS audit results

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall set up a monitoring program aimed at collecting and analysing data in order to provide, to the extent feasible, evidence of the in-service safety performance of the DCAS and confirmatory evidence of the audit results of the Safety Management System requirements established in Annex 3 to this Regulation.
obligations.reason: Identical scope to old 7.1.2 under the same 7.1 heading; the wording is unchanged and only the page differs.

coverage.source_unit: 7.2 – heading 'Reporting of DCAS operation'
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; it contains no obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 7.2.1 – heading 'Initial notification of Safety-Critical Occurrences'
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; it contains no obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 7.2.1.1 – manufacturer shall notify the Type Approval Authority without unreasonable delay about safety-critical occurrences learned of through monitoring, where the system or its features were 'on' or switched 'on' within the last 5 s

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall notify the Type Approval Authority without unreasonable delay about any safety-critical occurrence the manufacturer becomes aware of through a monitoring program, where the system or its features were in 'on' mode, or had been switched to 'on' mode within the last 5 seconds before the safety-critical occurrence.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 7.2.1.1 under the same 7.2.1 Initial notification heading; actor, action, conditions and the 5 s value are unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 7.2.1.1.1 – for systems capable of system-initiated manoeuvres, the notification requirement applies to any instance where the feature was active within the last 7 s before the occurrence

obligations.text: For systems capable of system-initiated manoeuvres, the applicable notification requirement shall apply to any instance where the feature was active within the last 7 seconds before the safety-critical occurrence.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 7.2.1.1.1 with the same sub-clause position under 7.2.1.1; the 7 s window and the scope for system-initiated manoeuvres are unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 7.2.1.2 whole paragraph: initial notification may be limited to high-level data but shall contain information about features in 'on' mode or switched to 'on' within last 5 s before the occurrence, to extent available

obligations.text: The initial notification of a safety-critical occurrence may be limited to high-level data but shall contain information about the features in 'on' mode, or which had been switched to 'on' mode within the last 5 seconds before the occurrence (e.g., location, time, type of accident), to the extent such information is available at the time of notification.
obligations.reason: Identical wording and same scope as old o346 (7.2.1.2) under the same parent 7.2.1; the same obligation was merely re-paginated (p27 to p30).

coverage.source_unit: 7.2.2 heading only: Short-term Reporting of Safety-Critical Occurrences
7.2.2.1 first sentence: manufacturer shall investigate whether incident was related to DCAS operation and inform TAA of results as soon as possible
7.2.2.1 second sentence: if system operation likely a cause, manufacturer shall inform TAA of intended remedial actions addressing DCAS design, if applicable

obligations.text: Following the initial notification per paragraph 7.2.1, the manufacturer shall investigate whether the incident was related to DCAS operation and inform the Type Approval Authority of the results of this investigation as soon as possible.
obligations.reason: Same actor, action and scope as old o348 (7.2.2.1) with identical wording; unchanged.

obligations.text: If the operation of the system was likely one of the causes of the incident, the manufacturer shall in addition inform the Type Approval Authority of intended remedial action(s) addressing DCAS design, if applicable.
obligations.reason: Same conditional obligation as the second sentence of old o348 (7.2.2.1); unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 7.2.2.2 first sentence: if remedial action is to be taken, TAA shall upload information in English to DETA without undue delay, no later than 14 days after receipt
7.2.2.2 second sentence: information shall be sufficient to understand incident, cause and remedial action
7.2.2.2 third sentence: Annex 6 contains guidance for uploading
coverage.exclusion_reason: Informational cross-reference to guidance; no separate obligation.

coverage.source_unit: Footnote 4: DETA URL

obligations.text: If remedial action addressing DCAS design is to be taken by the manufacturer, the Type Approval Authority shall upload the information received from the manufacturer, in English, to the UNECE secure internet database "DETA" without undue delay but no later than 14 days after receipt, to communicate it to all Type Approval Authorities.
obligations.reason: Matches old o349 (7.2.2.2); same actor, trigger, 14-day limit and DETA upload; only minor wording difference ('the English language').

obligations.text: The information uploaded to DETA shall be sufficient to understand the incident, the cause of it and the remedial action.
obligations.reason: Same sufficiency requirement as in old o349 (7.2.2.2); unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 7.2.2.3 whole paragraph: TAA informed through other sources may request the manufacturer to provide available incident information as stipulated in 7.2.1 and 7.2.2

obligations.text: If the Type Approval Authority is informed of a safety-critical occurrence with a DCAS-equipped vehicle through sources other than the vehicle manufacturer (e.g., other Type Approval Authorities), it may request the manufacturer to provide available information on the incident in a comprehensive and accessible way as stipulated in 7.2.1 and 7.2.2.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o350 (7.2.2.3) in actor, trigger and permission; unchanged.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall report at least once a year to the Type Approval Authority on the information deemed proper evidence of intended operation collected through the monitoring program and of safety of the system in the field, until production is definitively discontinued according to paragraph 14.
obligations.reason: Same obligation as old 7.2.3.1 (o352), same scope and wording.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall report at least the information listed in Table 1 (Information for Periodic Reporting) in the periodic report.
obligations.reason: Same obligation as o352 requiring at least the table information; the table content changes are separate.

obligations.text: The reported information can be shared in confidence with other Type Approval Authorities on request; the manufacturer shall be notified in this case.
obligations.reason: Unchanged from o352.

obligations.text: The reported information is not intended to be shared publicly.
obligations.reason: New sentence not in old o352.

obligations.text: Additional information beyond Table 1 is subject to agreement between the Type Approval Authority and the manufacturer.
obligations.reason: Unchanged from o352.

obligations.text: If the system was subject to significant changes relevant to the reported information during the reporting period, the report shall differentiate the changes of the system.
obligations.reason: Unchanged from o352.

obligations.text: Table 1 item 1: report total safety-critical occurrences known to the manufacturer (with related hours of operation and distance travelled), differentiated by DCAS capability at the time (lane keeping; driver-initiated, driver-confirmed, system-initiated manoeuvres), and in each case whether the system was withholding HOR.
obligations.reason: Replaces old Table 1 item 1 (o353) with added differentiation by capability and HOR withholding.

obligations.text: Table 1 item 2: report number of vehicles equipped with the system; 2.a vehicles where the system was available to be switched ON during the period (if different); 2.b vehicles switched ON; 2.c vehicles from 2.a with no data received; 2.d aggregated distance by 2.a vehicles in 'passive' mode; 2.e aggregated distance in 'active' mode.
obligations.reason: Replaces old item 2 (o353), expanded into sub-items 2.a-2.e.

obligations.text: Table 1 item 3: report number of events resulting in a driver unavailability response (total, with related hours of operation and distance travelled).
obligations.reason: Same as old item 3 in o353.

obligations.text: Table 1 item 4: report number of system-initiated deactivations of the system or its features due to 4.a detected failures; 4.b exceeding system boundaries; 4.c exceeding system or feature boundaries while the driver is detected disengaged per 5.3.5.1; 4.d other (if applicable).
obligations.reason: Replaces old item 4 (o353) with new 4.c category and renumbered 'Other' as 4.d.

obligations.text: Table 1 item 5: report percentage of total distance travelled with a driver-set speed limit above the system-determined speed limit while the system is in 'active' mode.
obligations.reason: Same as old item 5 in o353.

obligations.text: Table 1 item 6: report disablement of the system due to insufficient driver engagement: 6.a events disabled per 5.5.4.2.8.2; 6.b events where powertrain was deactivated less than 5 minutes after disablement; 6.c events disabled due to repeated EOR warnings with description of number of warnings and manufacturer-defined interval per 5.5.4.2.8.3; 6.d same for repeated HOR warnings.
obligations.reason: Same as old items 6.a-6.d in o353.

obligations.text: Table 1 item 7: report 7.a number of events where 5 EORs are issued within a 10-minute period while the system is active, and 7.b same for 5 HORs; once recorded, counting of EOR/HOR is reset for reporting.
obligations.reason: Same as old items 7.a-7.b in o353.

obligations.text: Table 1 item 8 (if applicable), during phases of withholding HORs without driver override of longitudinal control: 8.a events where upcoming boundary is detected and HOR given at least 5 s in advance; 8.b events where HOR given but not at least 5 s in advance (see 5.5.4.2.6.5.1); 8.c driving distance and time while withholding HORs.
obligations.reason: Same as old items 8.a-8.c in o353.

obligations.text: Table 1 item 9 (if applicable): report number of started System-Initiated Manoeuvres in highway environment, with 9.a percentage driver-aborted, 9.b percentage system-aborted, 9.c percentage of System-Initiated Manoeuvres as per 5.3.7.2.4.10.
obligations.reason: Replaces old item 9 (number of aborted SIMs, o353) with started count, abort percentages and highway scope.

obligations.text: Table 1 item 10 (if applicable): report number of started System-Initiated Manoeuvres in non-highway environment, with 10.a percentage driver-aborted, 10.b percentage system-aborted, 10.c percentage of system-initiated manoeuvres as per 5.3.7.2.4.10.
obligations.reason: Separate non-highway reporting item with no equivalent in old table.

coverage.source_unit: 8.1 validation shall ensure thorough consideration of functional and operational safety, assessed per Annex 3

obligations.text: The validation of the system shall ensure that an acceptable thorough consideration of functional and operational safety of the features integrated in the system and the entire system integrated into a vehicle has been performed by the manufacturer, assessed according to Annex 3.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 8.1 (o354), same scope.

coverage.source_unit: 8.2 lead: validation shall demonstrate performance requirements of paragraphs 5 and 6 met
8.2(a) validation of safety aspects per Annex 3
8.2(b) physical tests on track and public roads per Annex 4
8.2(c) monitoring per paragraph 7

obligations.text: The validation of the system shall demonstrate that the features integrated in the system and the entire system meet the performance requirements specified in paragraphs 5 and 6 of this Regulation.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 8.2 (o355).

obligations.text: The validation of the system shall include validation of the system safety aspects in accordance with the requirements of Annex 3.
obligations.reason: Same as o355 item (a).

obligations.text: The validation of the system shall include physical tests on the test track and public roads in accordance with the requirements of Annex 4.
obligations.reason: Same as o355 item (b).

obligations.text: The validation of the system shall include monitoring of the system or its features in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 7.
obligations.reason: Same as o355 item (c).

coverage.source_unit: 8.2.1 sentence 1: validation may include virtual testing and metrics reporting (permission)
8.2.1 sentence 2: if virtual testing performed, credibility assessment per Annex 5 provided to TAA
Heading '9. System Information Data'

obligations.text: The validation of the system may include the use of virtual testing and reporting of metrics produced by virtual testing, such as coverage measurement and safety metrics.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 8.2.1 (o356).

obligations.text: If virtual testing is performed, a credibility assessment as described in Annex 5 shall be provided to the Type Approval Authority.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 8.2.1 (o356).

coverage.source_unit: 9.1 data shall be provided by manufacturer with Annex 3 documentation package to TAA at type-approval

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide the data listed in paragraph 9, together with the documentation package required in Annex 3, to the Type Approval Authority at the time of type-approval.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 9.1 (o357).

coverage.source_unit: 9.1.1 provide specific features per paragraph 6 classification, confirming with 'x' or 'Not Applicable' the operating domain and completing the table (speeds, preconditions)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide the specific features of the system according to the classification of paragraph 6, confirming with an 'x' or 'Not Applicable' what domain each feature can operate in, and completing the table (system minimum speed, system maximum speed, other relevant preconditions for activation) for positioning in the lane of travel, driver-initiated lane change, driver-confirmed lane change, other manoeuvres, system-initiated lane change and other features.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 9.1.1 (o358), same table and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 9.1.2 intro: manufacturer to confirm with 'x' or 'Not Applicable' the domain (highway/non-highway) in which each feature operates and complete the table
Table rows: feature names (positioning, lane changes, other manoeuvres) with Non-Highway/Highway columns
coverage.exclusion_reason: Table template layout; the obligation to complete it is captured in the intro unit

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide to the Type Approval Authority, with the Annex 3 documentation package at type-approval, the domains (highway or non-highway) in which the system provides each type of assistance classified under paragraph 9.1.1, confirming with an "x" or "Not Applicable" the domain in which each feature (positioning in the lane of travel, driver-initiated lane change, driver-confirmed lane change, other manoeuvres, system-initiated lane change) can operate, and completing the table, specifying variants where applicable.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old 9.1.2 (o359) with identical wording and table; same paragraph number, only page numbers changed.

coverage.source_unit: 9.1.3 whole: provide conditions for activation of system and features and boundary conditions

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide to the Type Approval Authority, with the Annex 3 documentation package at type-approval, the conditions under which the system and its features can be activated and the boundaries for operation (boundary conditions).
obligations.reason: Identical to old 9.1.3 (o360) under same parent 9.1; same actor, object and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 9.1.4 whole: provide DCAS interactions with other vehicle systems

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide to the Type Approval Authority, with the Annex 3 documentation package at type-approval, information on DCAS interactions with other vehicle systems.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 9.1.4 (o361) under same parent 9.1; unchanged scope.

coverage.source_unit: 9.1.5 whole: provide means to activate, deactivate and override the system

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide to the Type Approval Authority, with the Annex 3 documentation package at type-approval, the means to activate, deactivate and override the system.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 9.1.5 (o362) under same parent 9.1; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 9.1.6 whole: provide criteria monitored and means of monitoring driver disengagement

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide to the Type Approval Authority, with the Annex 3 documentation package at type-approval, the criteria monitored and the means by which driver disengagement is monitored.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 9.1.6 (o363) under same parent 9.1; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 9.1.7 whole: provide dynamic control assistance of each feature

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide to the Type Approval Authority, with the Annex 3 documentation package at type-approval, the dynamic control assistance provided by each feature of the system.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 9.1.7 (o364) under same parent 9.1; unchanged.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide to the Type Approval Authority at type-approval, with the documentation package, a yes/no declaration on whether the system continues to provide lateral control assistance, as input other than lane markings to determine the lane course, for lane marking(s) listed in UN Regulation No. 130 (operating domain requirement: Highway).
obligations.reason: Same scoped manufacturer data item as old 9.1.8 (o365), renumbered in page only; same table row, same actor and scope.

obligations.reason: Matches the same table row in old 9.1.8 (o365) with unchanged scope.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide to the Type Approval Authority at type-approval a yes/no declaration on whether the system continues to provide lateral control assistance when road edges are the input (operating domain requirement: Non-Highway).
obligations.reason: Matches the same table row in old 9.1.8 (o365) with unchanged scope.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide to the Type Approval Authority at type-approval a yes/no declaration on whether the system continues to provide lateral control assistance when the lane is demarked by something other than a lane marking (parked cars, curb, construction infrastructure) (operating domain requirement: Non-Highway).
obligations.reason: Matches the same table row in old 9.1.8 (o365) with unchanged scope.

coverage.source_unit: 10.1 first sentence: R171SWIN shall be implemented by the vehicle manufacturer
10.1 second sentence: R171SWIN may be held on the vehicle; if not held, manufacturer shall declare software versions to the TAA

obligations.text: For the purpose of ensuring the software of the System can be identified, the vehicle manufacturer shall implement an R171SWIN.
obligations.reason: Same obligation as old 10.1 (o366); same actor and object.

obligations.text: If the R171SWIN is not held on the vehicle, the manufacturer shall declare the software version(s) of the vehicle or single ECUs, with the connection to the relevant type approvals, to the Type Approval Authority. (The R171SWIN may be held on the vehicle.)
obligations.reason: Same as old 10.1 (o366) except the typo R1XXSWIN corrected to R171SWIN; substance unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 10.2 whole paragraph

obligations.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall demonstrate compliance with UN Regulation No. 156 (Software Update and Software Update Management System) by fulfilling the requirements and respecting the transitional provisions of the original version of UN Regulation No. 156 or later series of amendments.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 10.2 (o367) in actor, action and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 10.3(a) R171SWIN
10.3(b) How to read the R171SWIN or software version(s) if R171SWIN is not held on vehicle

obligations.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide the R171SWIN in the communication form of this UN Regulation.
obligations.reason: Same as old 10.3(a) (o368).

obligations.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide in the communication form of this UN Regulation how to read the R171SWIN or software version(s) in case the R171SWIN is not held on the vehicle.
obligations.reason: Same as old 10.3(b) (o368).

coverage.source_unit: 10.4 first sentence: manufacturer may provide list of relevant parameters
10.4 second sentence: information shall be declared by manufacturer and may not be verified by TAA

obligations.text: The vehicle manufacturer may provide in the communication form of the related Regulation a list of the relevant parameters that allow identification of those vehicles that can be updated with the software represented by the R171SWIN.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 10.4 (o369) first sentence.

obligations.text: The information provided on the relevant parameters shall be declared by the vehicle manufacturer and may not be verified by a Type Approval Authority.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 10.4 (o369) second sentence.

10.5 second sentence: may cover situations where regulations updated or hardware changed
coverage.exclusion_reason: Explanatory description of situations, not a separate obligation

Heading 11 Modification of vehicle type and extension of approval

obligations.text: The vehicle manufacturer may obtain a new vehicle approval for the purpose of differentiating software versions intended for vehicles already registered in the market from software versions used on new vehicles (e.g. where type approval regulations are updated or hardware changes are made in series production).
obligations.reason: Identical to old 10.5 (o370) first and second sentences.

obligations.text: In agreement with the Type Approval Authority, duplication of tests shall be avoided where possible when a new vehicle approval is obtained to differentiate software versions.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 10.5 (o370) third sentence.

coverage.source_unit: 11.1 first sentence: every modification of vehicle type (para 2.2) shall be notified to the approving Type Approval Authority
11.1(a) TAA considers no adverse effect and grants extension
11.1(b) TAA considers conditions affected and requires further tests/checks before extension
11.1(c) TAA decides in consultation with manufacturer that new type-approval is granted
11.1(d) TAA applies revision procedure 11.1.1 and, if applicable, extension procedure 11.1.2

obligations.text: Every modification of the vehicle type as defined in paragraph 2.2 shall be notified to the Type Approval Authority which approved the vehicle type.
obligations.reason: Same scoped modification-notification obligation as old 11.1 (o371); identical text, same paragraph number, same actor and scope.

obligations.text: Following notification of a modification, the Type Approval Authority shall, where it considers that the modifications do not have an adverse effect on the conditions of the granting of the approval, grant an extension of approval.
obligations.reason: Matches old 11.1(a) in o371; unchanged TAA option and scope.

obligations.text: Following notification of a modification, where the Type Approval Authority considers that the modifications affect the conditions of the granting of the approval, it shall require further tests or additional checks before granting an extension of approval.
obligations.reason: Matches old 11.1(b) in o371; unchanged.

obligations.text: Following notification of a modification, the Type Approval Authority may decide, in consultation with the manufacturer, that a new type-approval is to be granted.
obligations.reason: Matches old 11.1(c) in o371; unchanged.

obligations.text: Following notification of a modification, the Type Approval Authority shall apply the procedure in paragraph 11.1.1 (Revision) and, if applicable, the procedure in paragraph 11.1.2 (Extension).
obligations.reason: Matches old 11.1(d) in o371; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 11.1.1 first paragraph: modification designated a 'revision' when particulars changed and TAA considers unlikely appreciable adverse effects
11.1.1 second paragraph: TAA issues revised pages marked with nature of modification and date of re-issue
11.1.1 final sentence: consolidated updated information documents with detailed description deemed to meet requirement

obligations.text: When particulars recorded in the information documents have changed and the Type Approval Authority considers that the modifications are unlikely to have appreciable adverse effects, the modification shall be designated a "revision".
obligations.reason: Same revision designation as old 11.1.1 (o372); identical wording and scope.

obligations.text: In the case of a revision, the Type Approval Authority shall issue the revised pages of the information documents as necessary, marking each revised page to show clearly the nature of the modification and the date of re-issue.
obligations.reason: Same as old 11.1.1 (o372) page-issue obligation.

obligations.text: A consolidated, updated version of the information documents, accompanied by a detailed description of the modification, shall be deemed to meet the requirement to issue revised pages.
obligations.reason: Same alternative compliance means as old 11.1.1 (o372).

coverage.source_unit: 11.1.2 lead-in with (a)-(c): modification designated 'extension' if, in addition to change of particulars, any of (a) further inspections/tests, (b) communication document info changed, (c) approval to later series requested

obligations.text: The modification shall be designated an "extension" if, in addition to the change of the particulars recorded in the information documents, (a) further inspections or tests are required; or (b) any information on the communication document (except its attachments) has changed; or (c) approval to a later series of amendments is requested after its entry into force.
obligations.reason: Same designation criteria as old 11.1.2 (o373); identical wording; alternatives kept together as one obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 11.2 first sentence: confirmation or refusal of approval specifying alterations communicated per 4.3 to Contracting Parties
11.2 second sentence: index to information documents and test reports amended to show date of most recent revision or extension

obligations.text: Confirmation or refusal of approval, specifying the alterations, shall be communicated by the procedure specified in paragraph 4.3 to the Contracting Parties to the Agreement applying this UN Regulation.
obligations.reason: Same as old 11.2 (o374); unchanged.

obligations.text: The index to the information documents and to the test reports, attached to the communication document of Annex 1, shall be amended accordingly to show the date of the most recent revision or extension.
obligations.reason: Same as old 11.2 (o374) second sentence; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 11.3 first sentence: TAA informs other Contracting Parties of the extension via Annex 1 communication form
11.3 second sentence: TAA assigns serial extension number to each extension
Heading '12. Conformity of production'

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall inform the other Contracting Parties of the extension by means of the communication form which appears in Annex 1 to this UN Regulation.
obligations.reason: Same as old 11.3 (o375); unchanged.

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall assign a serial number to each extension, to be known as the extension number.
obligations.reason: Same as old 11.3 (o375) second sentence; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 12.1 conformity of production procedures shall conform to Article 2 and Schedule 1 of the Agreement and meet following requirements

obligations.text: Procedures for the conformity of production shall conform to the general provisions defined in Article 2 and Schedule 1 to the Agreement (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3) and meet the requirements that follow.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 12.1 (o376); same CoP scope and actor.

coverage.source_unit: 12.2 sentence: vehicle approved shall be manufactured to conform to approved type by meeting paragraph 5 requirements

obligations.text: A vehicle approved pursuant to this UN Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the approved type by meeting the requirements of paragraph 5.
obligations.reason: Same scoped conformity-of-production obligation as old clause o377 (12.2, same paragraph number, identical wording, same actor and object); not changed.

coverage.source_unit: 12.3 first sentence: Type Approval Authority may at any time verify conformity of control methods for each production unit
12.3 second sentence: normal inspection frequency once every two years

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority which has granted the approval may at any time verify the conformity of control methods applicable to each production unit.
obligations.reason: Matches old clause o378 (12.3): same actor (granting Type Approval Authority), same permission and object; unchanged.

obligations.text: The normal frequency of such inspections of conformity of control methods applicable to each production unit shall be once every two years.
obligations.reason: Matches old clause o378 (12.3) second sentence: same inspection frequency of once every two years; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 12.4: approval may be withdrawn if paragraph 8 requirements not complied with

obligations.text: The approval granted in respect of a vehicle type pursuant to this UN Regulation may be withdrawn if the requirements laid down in paragraph 8 are not complied with.
obligations.reason: Identical to old clause o379 (12.4), same paragraph reference (paragraph 8) and same withdrawal permission; distinct from o381 which refers to paragraph 12.

coverage.source_unit: 12.5: Contracting Party withdrawing an approval shall forthwith notify other Contracting Parties using Annex 1 communication form

obligations.text: If a Contracting Party withdraws an approval it had previously granted, it shall forthwith notify the other Contracting Parties applying this Regulation by sending them a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 1 to this UN Regulation.
obligations.reason: Matches old clause o380 (12.5): same actor, notification action and Annex 1 form; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 13.1: approval may be withdrawn if paragraph 12 requirements not complied with

obligations.text: The approval granted in respect of a vehicle type pursuant to this UN Regulation may be withdrawn if the requirements laid down in paragraph 12 are not complied with.
obligations.reason: Identical to old clause o381 (13.1), same paragraph 12 reference and same withdrawal permission; distinct from o379.

coverage.source_unit: 13.2: Contracting Party withdrawing an approval shall forthwith notify other Contracting Parties using Annex 1 communication form
Heading '14. Production definitively discontinued'

obligations.text: If a Contracting Party withdraws an approval it had previously granted, it shall forthwith notify the other Contracting Parties applying this UN Regulation by sending them a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 1 to this UN Regulation.
obligations.reason: Matches old clause o382 (13.2): same actor, notification action and Annex 1 form; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 14.1 – holder of approval who completely ceases manufacture of an approved type shall inform the Type Approval Authority
14.1 – Type Approval Authority shall forthwith inform other Contracting Parties using Annex 1 communication form

obligations.text: If the holder of the approval completely ceases to manufacture a type of vehicle approved under this UN Regulation, the holder shall inform the Type Approval Authority which granted the approval.
obligations.reason: Same actor, action and condition as old 14.1 (o383), identical wording and same paragraph number; unchanged.

obligations.text: Upon being informed that the approval holder has completely ceased manufacture of an approved vehicle type, the Type Approval Authority shall forthwith inform the other Contracting Parties applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 1.
obligations.reason: Same authority duty as old 14.1 (o383); identical scope and wording, only page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 14.2 – production is not considered definitively discontinued if manufacturer intends to obtain further approvals for software updates for vehicles already registered
Heading 15 Names and Addresses of Technical Services...

obligations.text: Production is not considered definitively discontinued if the vehicle manufacturer intends to obtain further approvals for software updates for vehicles already registered in the market.
obligations.reason: Same scoped provision as old 14.2 (o384); only spelling differs (definitely/definitively), no substantive change.
