coverage.source_unit: 16.1.4 - From 1 September 2030, Contracting Parties not obliged to accept 00 series approvals

obligations.text: As from 1 September 2030, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not be obliged to accept type approvals issued to the original version (00 series of amendments) of this Regulation.
obligations.reason: Relocation/renumbering of old 16.4 with identical actor, date and scope (00 series approvals), now placed under the 01 series transitional provisions 16.1.

coverage.source_unit: 16.1.5 - Notwithstanding the above, new Contracting Parties not obliged to accept 00 series approvals

obligations.text: Notwithstanding the transitional provisions above, Contracting Parties who start to apply this Regulation after the date of entry into force of the most recent series of amendments are not obliged to accept type approvals granted in accordance with the original version (00 series of amendments) of this Regulation.
obligations.reason: Renumbering of old 16.5 with the same actor, condition and scope (Contracting Parties starting to apply after the most recent amendments, 00 series approvals), now under 16.1.

coverage.source_unit: 16.1.6 - Contracting Parties may grant 00 series type approvals

obligations.text: Contracting Parties applying this Regulation may grant type approvals according to the original version (00 series of amendments) of this Regulation.
obligations.reason: Renumbering of old 16.6, same permission for the same actor and object, now under 16.1.

coverage.source_unit: 16.1.7 - Contracting Parties continue to grant extensions of existing 00 series approvals

obligations.text: Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall continue to grant extensions of existing approvals to the original version (00 series of amendments) of this Regulation.
obligations.reason: Renumbering of old 16.7 with identical actor, action and scope, now under 16.1.

coverage.source_unit: 16.2 - Heading: Transitional Provisions applicable to the 02 series of amendments
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading introducing transitional provisions; imposes no obligation itself.

coverage.source_unit: 16.2.1 – from entry into force of 02 series, no Contracting Party shall refuse to grant or accept type approvals under 02 series

obligations.text: As from the official date of entry into force of the 02 series of amendments, no Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall refuse to grant or refuse to accept type approvals under this Regulation as amended by the 02 series of amendments.
obligations.reason: Replaces o386 (16.1), the same scoped transitional obligation for the 01 series, now updated for the 02 series; same actor (Contracting Parties) and action (not refusing to grant or accept approvals), but a different series of amendments.

coverage.source_unit: 16.2.2 – from 1 September 2032, Contracting Parties not obliged to accept type approvals issued to the preceding series

obligations.text: As from 1 September 2032, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not be obliged to accept type approvals issued to the preceding series of amendments of this Regulation.
obligations.reason: Separately scoped cut-off for the preceding series (01) with a new date, 1 September 2032. Candidate o389 (16.4) concerns the 00 series and a 2030 date, so continuity of the same scoped obligation is not established.

coverage.source_unit: 16.2.3 – from 1 September 2029, not obliged to accept preceding series approvals for systems capable of withholding HORs on highway-like roads

obligations.text: As from 1 September 2029, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not be obliged to accept type approvals issued to the preceding series of amendments of this Regulation for systems capable of withholding HORs (as per paragraph 5.5.4.2.6.5.) on highway-like roads (as defined in paragraph 2.28.1).
obligations.reason: New scoped cut-off applying only to systems capable of withholding HORs on highway-like roads, with a 2029 date. No old equivalent exists.

coverage.source_unit: 16.3 heading – General Transitional Provisions
16.3.1 – Contracting Parties may grant type approvals according to any preceding series of amendments

obligations.text: Contracting Parties applying this Regulation may grant type approvals according to any preceding series of amendments to this Regulation.
obligations.reason: Generalises o391 (16.6), the same permission to grant type approvals to an earlier version, which previously covered only the original 00 series and now covers any preceding series.

coverage.source_unit: 16.3.2 – Contracting Parties shall continue to grant extensions of existing approvals to any preceding series

obligations.text: Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall continue to grant extensions of existing approvals to any preceding series of amendments to this Regulation.
obligations.reason: Generalises o392 (16.7), the same obligation to continue granting extensions of existing approvals, which previously covered only the 00 series and now covers any preceding series.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 heading: 'Communication 1'
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading/title of the communication form; not an engineering or compliance obligation.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 1 / 1 communication form (issued by, concerning approval granted/extended/refused/withdrawn/production discontinued of a vehicle type with regard to DCAS pursuant to UN Regulation No. 171, Approval No., reason for extension or revision, footnote 1 on country number)

obligations.text: The communication of approval, extension, refusal, withdrawal of approval or production definitively discontinued of a vehicle type with regard to DCAS pursuant to UN Regulation No. 171 shall use the Annex 1 form (maximum format A4, 210 x 297 mm), stating the issuing administration's name, the applicable decision (approval granted/extended/refused/withdrawn/production definitively discontinued), the Approval No., the reason for extension or revision, and the distinguishing number of the country that granted/extended/refused/withdrawn the approval.
obligations.reason: Same communication form as old o394 (Annex 1 / 1), same scope; the placeholder 'UN Regulation No. XXX' is replaced by 'No. 171' and the footnote numbering changed.

coverage.source_unit: Footnote 2: 'Strike out what does not apply.'
Items 1 and 2: trade name or mark of vehicle; vehicle type

obligations.text: In the Annex 1 communication form, entries that do not apply shall be struck out.
obligations.reason: Corresponds to old o396 (Annex 1 / 3) footnote 'Strike out what does not apply'; the same form instruction, only the footnote number differs.

obligations.text: The Annex 1 communication form shall state the trade name or mark of the vehicle (item 1) and the vehicle type (item 2).
obligations.reason: Same form items 1 and 2 as in old o396 (Annex 1 / 3) within the same communication form; item 3 now appears separately as n423.

coverage.source_unit: Item 3: Manufacturer's name and address

obligations.text: The Annex 1 communication form shall state the manufacturer's name and address (item 3).
obligations.reason: Same item 3 in the same Annex 1 communication form as in old o396, which previously included it combined with other items; scope unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: Item 4: If applicable, name and address of manufacturer's representative

obligations.text: If applicable, the Annex 1 communication form shall state the name and address of the manufacturer's representative (item 4).
obligations.reason: Identical to old o397 (Annex 1 / 4), same form and item.

coverage.source_unit: Item 5: General construction characteristics of the vehicle:

obligations.text: The Annex 1 communication form shall state the general construction characteristics of the vehicle (item 5).
obligations.reason: Identical to old o398 (Annex 1 / 5), same form item.

coverage.source_unit: 5.1 Photographs and/or drawings of a representative vehicle (information document entry)

obligations.text: The approval application information document (Annex 1, item 5.1) shall include photographs and/or drawings of a representative vehicle under the general construction characteristics of the vehicle.
obligations.reason: Same scoped information-document entry as old Annex 1 / 5.1 (o399) under the same parent heading 5; identical wording, only the page differs.

coverage.source_unit: 6. Description and/or drawing of the DCAS: see Section 9.

obligations.text: The information document (Annex 1, item 6) shall include a description and/or drawing of the DCAS as specified in Section 9.
obligations.reason: Same information-document item as old Annex 1 / 6 (o400); wording identical, only the page differs.

coverage.source_unit: 6.1 System is / is not capable of Driver-initiated manoeuvres; description of system capabilities
Footnote 2 Strike out what does not apply
coverage.exclusion_reason: Form instruction/footnote, not a separate obligation; the strike-out is covered in the declaration obligation.

obligations.text: The information document shall state, by striking out what does not apply, whether the system is / is not capable of performing Driver-initiated manoeuvres, and shall give a description of system capabilities.
obligations.reason: Continues old Annex 1 / 6.1 (o401), the same Driver-initiated manoeuvre declaration; only the footnote wording changed (country-number footnote replaced with a strike-out note).

coverage.source_unit: 6.2 System is / is not capable of Driver-confirmed manoeuvres; description of system capabilities
Footnote 2 Strike out what does not apply
coverage.exclusion_reason: Form instruction/footnote, not a separate obligation.

obligations.text: The information document shall state, by striking out what does not apply, whether the system is / is not capable of performing Driver-confirmed manoeuvres, and shall give a description of system capabilities.
obligations.reason: Continues old Annex 1 / 6.2 (o402), the same Driver-confirmed manoeuvre declaration; only the footnote wording changed.

coverage.source_unit: 6.3 System is / is not capable of System-initiated manoeuvres; description of system capabilities
Footnote 2 Strike out what does not apply
coverage.exclusion_reason: Form instruction/footnote, not a separate obligation.

obligations.text: The information document shall state, by striking out what does not apply, whether the system is / is not capable of performing System-initiated manoeuvres, and shall give a description of system capabilities.
obligations.reason: Continues old Annex 1 / 6.3 (o403), the same System-initiated manoeuvre declaration; only the footnote wording changed.

coverage.source_unit: 6.4 System is / is not capable of withholding of HORs
Footnote 2 Strike out what does not apply
coverage.exclusion_reason: Form instruction/footnote, not a separate obligation.

obligations.text: The information document shall state, by striking out what does not apply, whether the system is / is not capable of withholding of HORs.
obligations.reason: Continues old Annex 1 / 6.4 (o404), the same HOR-withholding capability declaration; only the footnote wording changed.

coverage.source_unit: 6.4.1 statement: system is / is not capable of withholding HORs on highway-like roads (strike out what does not apply)

obligations.text: In the approval communication/information form, the manufacturer/applicant shall declare, by striking out what does not apply, whether the system is or is not capable of withholding HORs on highway-like roads.
obligations.reason: Paragraph 6.4.1 did not exist before. Old o404 (6.4) only covers general HOR withholding capability declaration; the highway-like-roads scoped declaration is a separate declaration item. o145 is a functional requirement, not a declaration.

coverage.source_unit: 7. Heading: Cyber Security and Software updates
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; the obligations are in 7.1 and 7.2.

coverage.source_unit: 7.1 Cyber Security Type Approval Number (if applicable)

obligations.text: The applicant shall state the Cyber Security Type Approval Number in the communication form, if applicable.
obligations.reason: Same scoped item as old o406 (Annex 1 / 7.1), identical wording and context under heading 7.

coverage.source_unit: 7.2 Software Update Type approval number (if applicable)

obligations.text: The applicant shall state the Software Update Type approval number in the communication form, if applicable.
obligations.reason: Same scoped item as old o407 (Annex 1 / 7.2), same paragraph number, wording and parent heading.

coverage.source_unit: 8. Heading: Special requirements for safety aspects of electronic control systems (Annex 3)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; the obligations are in sub-items.

coverage.source_unit: 8.1 Manufacturer's document reference for Annex 3 (including version number)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall state in the communication form the manufacturer's document reference for Annex 3, including the version number.
obligations.reason: Same scoped item as old o409 (Annex 1 / 8.1), same number, wording and parent heading 8.

coverage.source_unit: 8.2. Information document form (Appendix 1 to Annex 3) - communication form entry

obligations.text: The communication form shall include the information document form (Appendix 1 to Annex 3) entry (Annex 1, item 8.2).
obligations.reason: Same item 8.2 under item 8 with identical wording and scope as o410; page renumbered only.

coverage.source_unit: 9. Technical Service responsible for conducting approval tests - communication form entry

obligations.text: The communication form shall identify the Technical Service responsible for conducting approval tests (Annex 1, item 9).
obligations.reason: Identical item 9 in o411 with same scope; only the page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 9.1. Date of report issued by that service

obligations.text: The communication form shall state the date of the report issued by the Technical Service (Annex 1, item 9.1).
obligations.reason: Matches o412, same item under item 9 with identical wording.

coverage.source_unit: 9.2. (Reference) Number of the report issued by that service

obligations.text: The communication form shall state the (reference) number of the report issued by the Technical Service (Annex 1, item 9.2).
obligations.reason: Matches o413, same item under item 9 with identical wording.

coverage.source_unit: 10. Approval granted/extended/revised/refused/withdrawn, strike out what does not apply

obligations.text: The communication form shall indicate whether approval is granted/extended/revised/refused/withdrawn, striking out what does not apply (Annex 1, item 10).
obligations.reason: Same item 10 as o414 with the same strike-out instruction; footnote numbering differs only.

coverage.source_unit: 11. Position of approval mark on vehicle

obligations.text: The communication form shall state the position of the approval mark on the vehicle (Annex 1, item 11).
obligations.reason: Identical to o415, same item and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 12. Place (communication form item heading/field label)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Form field label only; no engineering, manufacturer, test or compliance obligation stated.

coverage.source_unit: 13. Date (communication form item label)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Form field label only; no obligation stated.

coverage.source_unit: 14. Signature (communication form item label)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Form field label only; no obligation stated.

coverage.source_unit: 15. Annexed to this communication is a list of documents in the approval file ... obtainable upon request (scope: communication form)
Additional information (label)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading/field label for additional information; no obligation.

obligations.text: The communication form shall have annexed to it a list of the documents in the approval file deposited at the administration services that delivered the approval; these documents can be obtained upon request.
obligations.reason: Same communication-form item relocated at same paragraph number (Annex 1 / 15); candidate o419 has identical wording, actor and scope (communication form annex list of approval-file documents).

coverage.source_unit: 16. R171SWIN: (communication form item label)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Form field label only; specific information requirements are in sub-items 16.1/16.2.

coverage.source_unit: 16.1. Information on how to read the R171SWIN or software version(s) in case the R171SWIN is not held on the vehicle (communication form entry)

obligations.text: The communication form shall include information on how to read the R171SWIN or the software version(s) in case the R171SWIN is not held on the vehicle.
obligations.reason: Same form item at same paragraph number (Annex 1 / 16.1) as candidate o421 with identical wording and scope; also consistent with the requirement in 10.3(b).

coverage.source_unit: 16.2 (If applicable, list relevant parameters identifying vehicles that can be updated with the R171SWIN software)

obligations.text: If applicable, the communication form (Annex 1, item 16.2) shall list the relevant parameters that allow identification of those vehicles that can be updated with the software represented by the R171SWIN given under item 16.
obligations.reason: Same scoped Annex 1 item 16.2 communication-form entry, identical wording and parent item 16 (R171SWIN); matches old clause o422, only the page changed.

coverage.source_unit: Model A approval mark arrangement (see paragraph 4.4), a = 8 mm min, with explanation of the Netherlands E4 approval No. 002439 in the original version of R171
Model B approval mark arrangement (see paragraph 4.5), a = 8 mm min, combined approval under UN Regulations Nos. 171 and 31

obligations.text: Approval mark Model A (see paragraph 4.4) for a vehicle type approved with regard to DCAS under UN Regulation No. 171 shall be arranged as shown, with dimension a = 8 mm minimum, the approval number indicating approval in accordance with R171 in its original version.
obligations.reason: Same Model A approval mark arrangement as old Annex 2 (o423); unchanged scope and content, only the page changed.

obligations.text: Approval mark Model B (see paragraph 4.5) for a vehicle type approved under UN Regulations Nos. 171 and 31 shall be arranged as shown, with dimension a = 8 mm minimum, the approval numbers indicating the version/series of each Regulation at the date of approval.
obligations.reason: Same Model B approval mark arrangement as old Annex 2 (o423); unchanged scope and content.

coverage.source_unit: Footnote 1: The second number is given merely as an example
Annex 3 heading
Para 1: Annex defines special requirements for documentation, safety by design and verification; does not specify performance criteria
Para 1: information disclosed shall show The System respects performance requirements under non-fault and fault conditions and is free of unreasonable safety risks
Para 1: 'the system shall...' provisions must always be complied with; failure constitutes non-compliance
Para 1: 'shall aim to' provisions acknowledge the requirement may not always be achieved
coverage.exclusion_reason: Interpretive statement; the manufacturer's duty is captured in the demonstration obligation.

coverage.source_unit: Para 1: 'shall be designed to' provisions verified by assessment of the system design
coverage.exclusion_reason: Interpretive statement; the manufacturer's duty is captured in the demonstration obligation.

coverage.source_unit: Para 1: if a 'shall aim to'/'shall be designed to' requirement is not fulfilled, manufacturer shall demonstrate why and how the system remains free from unreasonable risk

obligations.text: The information disclosed to the Type Approval Authority for type approval shall show that The System respects, under non-fault and fault conditions, all appropriate performance requirements of UN R171 and is designed to operate free of unreasonable safety risks to the driver, passengers and other road users.
obligations.reason: Same General paragraph as old Annex 3 / 1 (o426), identical wording.

obligations.text: Provisions of the form 'the system shall...' must always be complied with; failure to meet such a requirement during assessment constitutes non-compliance with UN R171.
obligations.reason: Identical to the corresponding sentence in old Annex 3 / 1 (o426).

obligations.text: If during assessment a requirement of the form 'shall aim to...' or 'shall be designed to...' is not fulfilled, the manufacturer shall demonstrate to the satisfaction of the Type Approval Authority why this was the case and how the system nevertheless remains free from unreasonable risk.
obligations.reason: Identical to the corresponding sentence in old Annex 3 / 1 (o426).

coverage.source_unit: Annex 3 / 2 Definitions heading and introductory phrase
2.1 first sentence: definition of "the system" including other in-scope systems and transmission links, and the DCAS alias
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; it sets the scope of terms in Annex 3 and imposes no product, manufacturer or test requirement.

coverage.source_unit: 2.2 definition of "Safety Concept", including optional fallback
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; no independent requirement is created.

coverage.source_unit: 2.3 definition of "Electronic Control System"
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; no requirement is created.

coverage.source_unit: 2.4 definition of "Complex Electronic Control Systems", including the inclusion of transmission links
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; the inclusion statement only sets the definitional scope.

coverage.source_unit: 2.5 definition of "Higher-Level Electronic Control"
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; no requirement is created.

coverage.source_unit: 2.6 definition of "Units"
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; no requirement is created.

coverage.source_unit: 2.7 definition of "Transmission links" (whole paragraph)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; imposes no engineering, test or compliance requirement.

coverage.source_unit: 2.8 definition of "Range of control"
2.9 definition of "Boundary of functional operation" and alias "System Boundaries"
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition and terminology alias only; no obligation imposed.

coverage.source_unit: 2.10 definition of "Safety Related Function"
2.11 definition of "Control Strategy" including examples of deactivation/restrictions
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; 'may include' is descriptive, not a mandatory requirement.

coverage.source_unit: 2.12 definition of "Fault"
2.13 definition of "Failure"
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; imposes no engineering, test or compliance obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 2.14 definition of "Unreasonable risk"
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition only; imposes no obligation by itself.

coverage.source_unit: 3. Documentation heading
3.1 para 1 sentence 1: manufacturer provides documentation package on basic design and links/outputs
3.1 sentence 2: function(s) and safety concept explained
3.1 sentence 3: documentation brief but evidencing expertise from all involved system fields
3.1 sentence 4: periodic technical inspection description of operational status check
3.1 TAA assessment intro with (a): free from unreasonable risk under non-fault and fault conditions
3.1 (b): respects all performance requirements under non-fault and fault conditions
3.1 (c): developed according to manufacturer's chosen process per 3.4.4

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide a documentation package which gives access to the basic design of the system and the means by which it is linked to other vehicle systems or by which it directly controls output variables.
obligations.reason: Same scoped manufacturer documentation obligation as old Annex 3 / 3.1 (o445); identical wording and same paragraph number.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall explain the function(s) of the system and the safety concept, as laid down by the manufacturer.
obligations.reason: Unchanged in o445 with the same scope.

obligations.text: The documentation shall be brief, yet provide evidence that the design and development has had the benefit of expertise from all the system fields which are involved.
obligations.reason: Unchanged in o445 with the same scope.

obligations.text: For periodic technical inspections, the documentation shall describe how the current operational status of the system can be checked.
obligations.reason: Unchanged in o445 with the same scope.

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall assess the documentation package to show that the System is designed to operate, under non-fault and fault conditions, in such a way that it is free from unreasonable risk.
obligations.reason: Unchanged in o445 (a) with the same scope.

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall assess the documentation package to show that the System respects, under non-fault and fault conditions, all the appropriate performance requirements specified elsewhere in this UN Regulation.
obligations.reason: Unchanged in o445 (b) with the same scope.

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall assess the documentation package to show that the System was developed according to the development process/method chosen by the manufacturer according to paragraph 3.4.4.
obligations.reason: Unchanged in o445 (c) with the same scope.

coverage.source_unit: 3.1.1 intro and (a) part 1: formal documentation package supplied to the TAA at the time of application
3.1.1 (a): package used by the TAA as basic reference for verification per paragraph 4
3.1.1 (a): TAA ensures package remains available for at least 10 years after production definitively discontinued
3.1.1 (b): confidential material and analysis data of 3.4.4 retained by the manufacturer and open for inspection at type approval
3.1.1 (b): manufacturer ensures material remains available for 10 years after production definitively discontinued

obligations.text: The formal documentation package for approval, containing the material listed in paragraph 3 (except that of paragraph 3.4.4), shall be supplied to the Type Approval Authority at the time of submission of the type approval application.
obligations.reason: Same as o446 (a); only change in the old text is 'definitely' to 'definitively', which is not substantive.

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall use the formal documentation package as the basic reference for the verification process set out in paragraph 4 of this Annex.
obligations.reason: Unchanged in o446 (a).

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall ensure that the formal documentation package remains available for a period determined in agreement with the Type Approval Authority, which shall be at least 10 years counted from the time when production of the vehicle is definitively discontinued.
obligations.reason: Same as o446 (a); only wording 'definitely' to 'definitively'.

obligations.text: Additional confidential material and analysis data (intellectual property) of paragraph 3.4.4 shall be retained by the manufacturer but made open for inspection (e.g., on-site in the manufacturer's engineering facilities) at the time of type approval.
obligations.reason: Unchanged in o446 (b).

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall ensure that the confidential material and analysis data of paragraph 3.4.4 remains available for a period of 10 years counted from the time when production of the vehicle is definitively discontinued.
obligations.reason: Same as o446 (b); only 'definitely' to 'definitively'.

coverage.source_unit: 3.2 para 1: description of all functions, control strategies, methods and control mechanism(s)
3.2 para 2: identify any described function and describe changed rationale of operation
3.2 para 3: declare enabled or disabled safety related functions present in hardware/software at production, subject to Annex requirements prior to use

obligations.text: A description shall be provided giving a simple explanation of all the functions, including control strategies, of the system and the methods employed to achieve the objectives, including a statement of the mechanism(s) by which control is exercised.
obligations.reason: Identical to o447 with the same scope.

obligations.text: Any described function shall be identified and a further description of the changed rationale of the function's operation provided.
obligations.reason: Identical to o447 with the same scope.

obligations.text: Any enabled or disabled safety related functions providing assistance to the driver as defined in paragraph 2.1 of this UN Regulation, when the hardware and software are present in the vehicle at the time of production, shall be declared and are subject to the requirements of this Annex, prior to their use in the vehicle.
obligations.reason: Identical to o447 with the same scope.

coverage.source_unit: 3.2.1 sentence: list of all input and sensed variables, working range defined, and description of how each variable affects system behaviour (single documentation obligation)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide documentation listing all input and sensed variables, defining the working range of each, and describing how each variable affects system behaviour.
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation obligation as o448 (Annex 3 / 3.2.1), identical wording under the same parent 3.2; paragraph existed before with no change.

coverage.source_unit: 3.2.2 sentence: list of all output variables controlled by the system, explanation of direct or indirect control, and definition of control range (single documentation obligation)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide documentation listing all output variables controlled by the system, explaining for each whether control is direct or via another vehicle system, and defining the range of control exercised on each variable.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as o449 (Annex 3 / 3.2.2), identical wording and parent context; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.2.3 sentence: limits defining boundaries of functional operation stated where appropriate to system performance

obligations.text: The documentation shall state the limits defining the boundaries of functional operation, where appropriate to system performance.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as o450 (Annex 3 / 3.2.3), identical wording and parent context; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.2.4 sentence: declaration of capability of the system and its features per Appendix 4 model

obligations.text: A declaration of the capability of the system and its features shall be provided according to the model in Appendix 4 to Annex 3.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as o451 (Annex 3 / 3.2.4), identical wording and parent context; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3 heading: System layout and schematics
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; imposes no obligation itself (requirements are in subparagraph 3.3.1).

coverage.source_unit: 3.3.1 first requirement: list collating all units of the system and mentioning other vehicle systems needed for the control function
3.3.1 second requirement: outline schematic showing units in combination with equipment distribution and interconnections clear

obligations.text: A list shall be provided collating all the units of the system and mentioning the other vehicle systems which are needed to achieve the control function in question.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as part of o453 (Annex 3 / 3.3.1), identical wording and parent 3.3; unchanged.

obligations.text: An outline schematic showing the system units in combination shall be provided, with both the equipment distribution and the interconnections made clear.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as part of o453 (Annex 3 / 3.3.1), identical wording and parent context; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3.2 first sentence, part 1: function of each unit of the system shall be outlined
3.3.2 first sentence, part 2: signals linking each unit with other units or other vehicle systems shall be shown
3.3.2 second sentence: may be provided by labelled block diagram, schematic, or description aided by diagram (alternative means, permission)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Alternative means of satisfying the outline/show obligations; captured within obligation texts 0 and 1, not a separate obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3.2 heading 'Functions of the units'

obligations.text: In the system layout and schematics documentation, the function of each unit of the system shall be outlined; this may be provided by a labelled block diagram or other schematic, or by a description aided by such a diagram.
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation obligation as old o454 (Annex 3 / 3.3.2), same actor, object and parent context (Documentation / System layout and schematics); wording and scope unchanged.

obligations.text: In the system layout and schematics documentation, the signals linking each unit with other units or with other vehicle systems shall be shown; this may be provided by a labelled block diagram or other schematic, or by a description aided by such a diagram.
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation obligation as old o454 (Annex 3 / 3.3.2), same object (signals linking units) and parent context; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3.3 first sentence: interconnections within the system shall be shown by circuit diagram (electric), piping diagram (pneumatic/hydraulic), simplified diagrammatic layout (mechanical linkages)
3.3.3 second sentence: transmission links both to and from other systems shall also be shown

obligations.text: Interconnections within the system shall be shown by a circuit diagram for electric transmission links, by a piping diagram for pneumatic or hydraulic transmission equipment, and by a simplified diagrammatic layout for mechanical linkages.
obligations.reason: Identical scoped documentation obligation as old o455 (Annex 3 / 3.3.3) under the same parent context.

obligations.text: The transmission links both to and from other systems shall also be shown in the interconnection documentation.
obligations.reason: Same obligation as the second sentence of old o455 (Annex 3 / 3.3.3); unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3.4 first sentence: clear correspondence between transmission links and signals carried between units
3.3.4 second sentence: priorities of signals on multiplexed data paths shall be stated wherever priority may affect performance or safety

obligations.text: There shall be a clear correspondence between transmission links and the signals carried between units.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old o456 (Annex 3 / 3.3.4), identical wording and parent context.

obligations.text: Priorities of signals on multiplexed data paths shall be stated wherever priority may be an issue affecting performance or safety.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old o456 (Annex 3 / 3.3.4), unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3.5 first sentence: each unit clearly and unambiguously identifiable (marking for hardware, marking or software output for software)
3.3.5 second sentence: where functions combined within a single unit/computer but shown in multiple blocks, only a single hardware identification marking shall be used
3.3.5 third sentence: manufacturer shall, by use of identification, affirm equipment supplied conforms to the corresponding document

obligations.text: Each unit shall be clearly and unambiguously identifiable (e.g. by marking for hardware and marking or software output for software content) to provide corresponding hardware and documentation association.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old o457 (Annex 3 / 3.3.5); wording unchanged, only page layout differs.

obligations.text: Where functions are combined within a single unit or within a single computer but shown in multiple blocks in the block diagram, only a single hardware identification marking shall be used.
obligations.reason: Same as old o457 second sentence; unchanged scope.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall, by the use of the unit identification, affirm that the equipment supplied conforms to the corresponding document.
obligations.reason: Same as old o457 final sentence; unchanged manufacturer obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3.5.1 first part: the identification defines the hardware and software version
3.3.5.1 second part: where software changes so as to alter the function of the Unit as far as this Regulation is concerned, the identification shall also be changed

obligations.text: The unit identification shall define the hardware and software version.
obligations.reason: Same scoped requirement as old o458 (Annex 3 / 3.3.5.1) under the same parent 3.3.5; unchanged.

obligations.text: Where the software changes such as to alter the function of the unit as far as this Regulation is concerned, the unit identification shall also be changed.
obligations.reason: Same conditional obligation as old o458 (Annex 3 / 3.3.5.1); unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4 heading 'Safety concept of the manufacturer'
3.4.1 para 1 sentence 1: manufacturer shall provide statement affirming strategy will not prejudice safe operation under non-fault conditions
3.4.1 para 1 sentence 2: manufacturer shall supplement statement with explanation of how strategy ensures objectives do not prejudice safe operation, and description of validation plan part
3.4.1 para 2: Type Approval Authority shall assess explanation understandable/logical and validation plan suitable and completed
3.4.1 para 3: TAA may perform or require tests per paragraph 4 to verify system operates per chosen strategy

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide a statement affirming that the strategy chosen to achieve the system objectives will not, under non-fault conditions, prejudice the safe operation of the vehicle.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old 3.4.1 (o460) in the same paragraph number, identical wording and scope; page change only.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall supplement the statement with an explanation showing in overall terms how the chosen strategy ensures that the system objectives do not prejudice the safe operation of the systems referred to, and with a description of the part of the validation plan supporting the statement.
obligations.reason: Identical to the corresponding obligation in old 3.4.1 (o460), same paragraph, actor and scope.

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall perform an assessment to establish that the manufacturer's explanation of the chosen strategy is understandable and logical and that the validation plan is suitable and has been completed.
obligations.reason: Identical to the assessment obligation in old 3.4.1 (o460).

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority may perform tests, or may require tests to be performed, as specified in paragraph 4 of Annex 3, to verify that the system operates as per the chosen strategy.
obligations.reason: Identical permission in old 3.4.1 (o460).

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.2 sentence 1: for software in the system, outline architecture explained and design methods and tools identified
3.4.2 sentence 2: manufacturer shall show evidence of means by which realisation of system logic was determined during design and development

obligations.text: In respect of software employed in the system, the outline architecture shall be explained and the design methods and tools used shall be identified.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 3.4.2 (o461), same paragraph and scope.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall show evidence of the means by which they determined the realisation of the system logic during the design and development process.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 3.4.2 (o461), same paragraph and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.3 sentence 1: manufacturer shall provide TAA an explanation of design provisions for safe operation under fault conditions
3.4.3 examples (a)-(c): possible design provisions (fall-back, change-over, removal of high-level function)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Illustrative examples ('for example'), not mandatory requirements.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide the Type Approval Authority with an explanation of the design provisions built into the system so as to generate safe operation under fault conditions (possible provisions: fall-back to partial system, change-over to separate back-up system, removal of the high-level function).
obligations.reason: Identical to old 3.4.3 (o462), same paragraph, actor and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.3.1: if partial performance mode chosen under certain fault conditions, conditions stated and limits of effectiveness defined

obligations.text: If the chosen provision selects a partial performance mode of operation under certain fault conditions, these conditions shall be stated and the resulting limits of effectiveness defined.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 3.4.3.1 (o463), same paragraph and condition.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.3.2: if back-up means chosen, explain change-over principles, redundancy logic/level, built-in back-up checking, and define limits of back-up effectiveness

obligations.text: If the chosen provision selects a second (back-up) means to realise the vehicle control system objective, the principles of the change-over mechanism, the logic and level of redundancy and any built-in back-up checking features shall be explained and the resulting limits of back-up effectiveness defined.
obligations.reason: Same as old 3.4.3.2 (o464); only a hyphenation change ('built-in'), no substantive change.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.3.3: if removal of higher-level function chosen, all associated output control signals inhibited so as to limit transition disturbance

obligations.text: If the chosen provision selects the removal of the higher-level function, all the corresponding output control signals associated with this function shall be inhibited, in such a manner as to limit the transition disturbance.
obligations.reason: Identical to old 3.4.3.3 (o465), same paragraph and condition.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.4 para 1: documentation supported by analysis of system behaviour on any individual hazard or fault affecting vehicle control performance or safety
3.4.4 para 2: analytical approach(es) established and maintained by manufacturer and open for inspection at type approval
3.4.4 para 3: TAA shall assess application of analytical approach(es)
(a) concept-level inspection with (i)-(iv) considerations and optional Hazard/Risk analysis basis
(b) system-level safety approach inspection, top-down and bottom-up, may be based on FMEA/FTA/STPA
(c) inspection of validation plans and results
Assessment consists of checks of hazards, faults and failure conditions chosen by TAA
TAA may perform or require tests per paragraph 4

obligations.text: The manufacturer's documentation shall be supported by an analysis showing, in overall terms, how the system will behave on the occurrence of any individual hazard or fault that has a bearing on vehicle control performance or safety.
obligations.reason: Same wording and scope as old Annex 3 / 3.4.4 (o466), same parent 3.4; only renumbered pages.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall establish and maintain the chosen analytical approach(es) and make them open for inspection by the Type Approval Authority at the time of type approval.
obligations.reason: Unchanged from o466, same actor and scope.

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall perform an assessment of the application of the analytical approach(es).
obligations.reason: Unchanged from o466.

obligations.text: The assessment shall include inspection of the safety approach at the concept (vehicle) level, confirming it considers: (i) interactions with other vehicle systems; (ii) malfunctions of the system within the scope of this Regulation, including controllability aspects per paragraph 5.3.6; (iii) for functions defined in paragraph 3.2: situations where a fault-free system may create safety-critical risks (e.g. lack of or wrong comprehension of the vehicle environment), operational and system limitations, reasonably foreseeable driver misuse, intentional modification of the system; (iv) cyber-attacks impacting vehicle safety. This approach may be based on a Hazard/Risk analysis appropriate to system safety.
obligations.reason: Unchanged from o466 (a).

obligations.text: The assessment shall include inspection of the safety approach at the system level, which includes top-down and bottom-up approaches; it may be based on FMEA, FTA, STPA or any similar process appropriate to system functional and operational safety.
obligations.reason: Unchanged from o466 (b).

obligations.text: The assessment shall include inspection of the validation plans and results; this validation shall/may include appropriate validation testing, e.g. HIL testing, vehicle on-road operational testing, or any other appropriate testing.
obligations.reason: Unchanged from o466 (c).

obligations.text: The assessment shall consist of checks of hazards, faults and failure conditions chosen by the Type Approval Authority to establish that the manufacturer's explanation of the safety concept is understandable and logical and that the validation plans are suitable and have been completed.
obligations.reason: Unchanged from o466.

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority may perform tests or may require tests to be performed as specified in paragraph 4 to verify the safety concept.
obligations.reason: Unchanged permission from o466.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.4.1 documentation itemizes monitored parameters and sets out warning signal per failure condition

obligations.text: The documentation shall itemize the parameters being monitored and shall set out, for each relevant failure condition of the type defined in paragraph 3.4.4 of Annex 3, the warning signal to be given to the driver and/or to service/technical inspection personnel.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o467 with same parent and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.4.2 para 1: measures for safe operation when performance affected by environmental conditions
3.4.4.2 para 2: measures for compliance with particular environmental requirements

obligations.text: The documentation shall describe the measures in place to ensure the system does not prejudice safe operation of the vehicle when system performance is affected by environmental conditions (e.g. climatic, temperature, dust ingress, water ingress, ice packing).
obligations.reason: Identical to o468 first paragraph.

obligations.text: Where this Regulation contains particular requirements for operation of the system under different environmental conditions, the documentation shall describe the measures in place to ensure compliance with those requirements.
obligations.reason: Identical to o468 second paragraph.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.5 documentation outlines system information strategy encouraging driver to review information

obligations.text: The documentation shall outline a system information strategy which aims to encourage the driver to review information on system operation when the driver operates the system (e.g. a regular notification at the start of the drive cycle when the system is switched to 'on' mode proposing the driver review relevant materials).
obligations.reason: Relocated/renumbered from old 3.5.7 (o476) with the same actor, action and object; example wording changed from 'inviting' to 'proposing'. Continuity supported by near-identical text.

coverage.source_unit: 3.5 heading: Safety Management System (Process Audit)
3.5.1 sentence 1: manufacturer demonstrates SMS with effective processes, methodologies and tools across product lifecycle
3.5.1 sentence 2: manufacturer demonstrates at least every three years that SMS continues to comply

obligations.text: In respect of software and hardware employed in the system, the manufacturer shall demonstrate to the Type Approval Authority, in terms of a safety management system, that effective processes, methodologies and tools are in place, up to date and being followed within the organization to manage safety and continued compliance throughout the product lifecycle (design, development, production and operation).
obligations.reason: Same as first sentence of old 3.5.1 (o470), same actor, action and scope.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall demonstrate to the Type Approval Authority at least every three years that the safety management system continues to comply with the requirements of paragraph 3.5.1.
obligations.reason: The three-year periodic re-demonstration sentence is absent from old o470; it is a new sentence imposing a separate recurring obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 3.5.2 lead-in: SMS shall comprise key components (a)-(d)

obligations.text: The manufacturer's safety management system shall comprise the following key components: (a) safety policy and objectives (establishing safety practices with a clear safety policy, safety roles and responsibilities, and organizational safety objectives); (b) safety risk management to manage risk proactively; (c) safety assurance to monitor, analyse and measure overall safety performance; (d) safety promotion to ensure adequate information, education and heightened safety awareness of employees.
obligations.reason: Same paragraph number 3.5.2 under the same parent (Annex 3 / 3.5); the wording and scope of components (a)-(d) are identical to o471, so this is the same obligation, renumbered only in page position.

coverage.source_unit: 3.5.3 design and development process shall be established including listed elements

obligations.text: The design and development process shall be established including safety-by-design, requirements management, requirements' implementation, testing, failure tracking, remedy and release.
obligations.reason: Same paragraph 3.5.3 in the same Safety Management System section; text identical to o472 with the same scope.

coverage.source_unit: 3.5.4 manufacturer shall institute and maintain communication channels between departments

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall institute and maintain effective communication channels between manufacturer departments responsible for functional/operational safety, cybersecurity and any other relevant disciplines related to the achievement of vehicle safety.
obligations.reason: Same paragraph 3.5.4 and identical text and scope as o473.

coverage.source_unit: 3.5.5 manufacturer shall establish processes to manage safety during the operation phase, including monitoring of DCAS operation and remedial actions when necessary

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall establish processes to manage safety during the operation phase of the product lifecycle, including carrying out monitoring of DCAS operation and taking remedial actions when necessary.
obligations.reason: No candidate contains this requirement. o474 (old 3.5.5) is the periodic audit obligation, which moved to new 3.5.6. o340 (7.1.1) only concerns monitoring of safety-critical occurrences, which is a different scope. This is a newly inserted operation-phase safety process obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 3.5.6 manufacturer shall demonstrate periodic independent internal process audits for processes per 3.5.1 to 3.5.5

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall demonstrate that periodic independent internal process audits are carried out to ensure that the processes established in accordance with paragraphs 3.5.1 to 3.5.5 are implemented consistently.
obligations.reason: Renumbered replacement of old 3.5.5 (o474), the same periodic independent internal audit obligation; the scope is extended from 3.5.1-3.5.4 to 3.5.1-3.5.5 because of the newly inserted 3.5.5.

coverage.source_unit: 3.5.7 manufacturer shall put in place supplier arrangements so supplier SMS complies with 3.5.1 (except vehicle-related aspects like operation), 3.5.2, 3.5.3 and 3.5.6

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall put in place suitable arrangements (e.g. contractual arrangements, clear interfaces, quality management system) with suppliers to ensure that the supplier safety management system complies with the requirements of paragraphs 3.5.1 (except for vehicle related aspects like "operation"), 3.5.2, 3.5.3 and 3.5.6.
obligations.reason: Renumbered replacement of old 3.5.6 (o475), the same supplier arrangement obligation; the cross-reference to the audit paragraph is updated from 3.5.5 to 3.5.6.

coverage.source_unit: 4. Verification and test (heading)
4.1 intro: functional operation of the system, as laid out in paragraph 3 documents, shall be tested as follows

obligations.text: The functional operation of the system, as laid out in the documents required in paragraph 3 of Annex 3, shall be tested as set out in the following sub-paragraphs.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as o478 (Annex 3 / 4.1), identical wording, same paragraph number and parent heading; continuity is positive.

coverage.source_unit: 4.1.1 heading
Sentence 1: TAA verifies the system under non-fault conditions by testing selected declared functions
Sentence 2: verification follows the manufacturer's test procedures unless this Regulation specifies one
Sentence 3: for input signals from systems outside scope, test uses relevant UN Regulation procedure or other means (e.g. simulation)
Sentence 4: for complex electronic systems, tests include scenarios where a declared function is overridden

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall verify the system under non-fault conditions by testing a number of selected functions from those declared by the manufacturer in paragraph 3.2 of Annex 3.
obligations.reason: Same as o479 (Annex 3 / 4.1.1), identical text and scope.

obligations.text: The verification of the performance of the selected functions shall follow the manufacturer's test procedures unless a test procedure is specified in this UN Regulation.
obligations.reason: Same as o479, identical sentence and scope.

obligations.text: Where the system is subject to input signal(s) from systems outside the scope of this UN Regulation, the test shall be conducted using the test procedure of the relevant UN Regulation, or by another means that generates the relevant input signal(s) (e.g. simulation).
obligations.reason: Same as o479, identical sentence and scope.

obligations.text: For complex electronic systems, the verification tests shall include scenarios whereby a declared function is overridden.
obligations.reason: Same as o479, identical sentence and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 4.1.1.1 verification results shall correspond with manufacturer's description incl. control strategies in 3.2

obligations.text: The verification results shall correspond with the description, including the control strategies, provided by the manufacturer in paragraph 3.2 of Annex 3.
obligations.reason: Same as o480 (Annex 3 / 4.1.1.1), identical wording and context.

coverage.source_unit: 4.1.2 heading
Sentence 1-2: reaction checked under failure of an individual unit by simulating internal faults; TAA checks at least one unit
Sentence 2 (second part): TAA shall not check reaction to multiple simultaneous failures
Sentence 3: TAA verifies tests include controllability and HMI aspects

obligations.text: The reaction of the system shall be checked under the influence of a failure in any individual unit by applying corresponding output signals to electrical units or mechanical elements to simulate the effects of internal faults within the unit; the Type Approval Authority shall conduct this check for at least one individual unit.
obligations.reason: Same as o481 (Annex 3 / 4.1.2), identical text and scope.

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall not check the reaction of "The System" to multiple simultaneous failures of individual units.
obligations.reason: Same as o481, identical limitation.

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall verify that the failure tests include aspects that may have an impact on vehicle controllability and user information/interaction (HMI aspects).
obligations.reason: Same as o481, identical sentence.

coverage.source_unit: 4.1.2.1 verification results shall correspond with documented failure analysis summary so safety concept confirmed adequate

obligations.text: The verification results shall correspond with the documented summary of the failure analysis, to a level of overall effect such that the safety concept and execution are confirmed as being adequate.
obligations.reason: Same as o482 (Annex 3 / 4.1.2.1), identical wording and context.

coverage.source_unit: 4.1.3 sentence: verification under non-fault (4.1.1.1) and fault (4.1.2.1) conditions shall be adequate from controllability perspective
4.1.3 heading 'Verification of the controllability'

obligations.text: The verification under non-fault conditions (paragraph 4.1.1.1.) and fault conditions (paragraph 4.1.2.1.) shall be adequate from a controllability perspective.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old Annex 3 / 4.1.3 (o483): identical actor, scope, referenced paragraphs and parent 4.1; only renumbered pages.

coverage.source_unit: 4.1.3.1 intro and list (a)-(e): non-exhaustive controllability strategies in relation to 5.3.6.2

obligations.text: In relation to paragraph 5.3.6.2., the strategies for ensuring controllability may include, but are not limited to: (a) limiting the system's steering output; (b) adjusting the vehicle's position in the lane of travel; (c) determining road type and attributes; (d) determining other road user behaviour; (e) driver monitoring used.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o484 (Annex 3 / 4.1.3.1), same permitted strategy list and context.

coverage.source_unit: 4.1.3.2 intro and list (a)-(f): non-exhaustive controllability strategies whilst withholding HORs

obligations.text: In relation to paragraph 5.3.6.2., the strategies for ensuring controllability whilst withholding HORs may include, but are not limited to: (a) not immediately terminating assistance and continuing control on an appropriate trajectory, e.g. when the driver is not detected holding the steering control and lane markings are temporarily not detected; (b) limiting or avoiding sudden vehicle motion to the extent possible, as outlined in the manufacturer's safety concept; (c) adjusting the vehicle's position in the lane of travel; (d) determining road type and attributes; (e) limiting the designed speed range or lateral acceleration range; (f) increasing warning times other than HOR and EOR to allow sufficient time for the driver to apply direct steering control after moving back the hands.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o485 (Annex 3 / 4.1.3.2), same scope and list.

coverage.source_unit: 4.2 first sentence: simulation tools and models may be used for verification of safety concept
4.2 second sentence: where used, methods shall be in accordance with Annex 5
4.2 third sentence: manufacturer shall demonstrate scope, validity and validation of simulation tool chain

obligations.text: Simulation tools and mathematical models may be used for verification of the safety concept, in particular for scenarios that are difficult on a test track or in real driving conditions.
obligations.reason: Same permission as old o486 (Annex 3 / 4.2), unchanged.

obligations.text: Where simulation tools and mathematical models are used for verification of the safety concept, such methods shall be in accordance with Annex 5 of this UN Regulation.
obligations.reason: Same requirement as old o486, unchanged.

obligations.text: Where simulation is used, the manufacturer shall demonstrate the scope of the simulation tool, its validity for the scenario concerned, and the validation performed for the simulation tool chain (correlation of outcome with physical tests).
obligations.reason: Same requirement as old o486, unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 4.2.1: if virtual testing performed, TAA shall evaluate declared results (safety metrics, coverage of system boundaries)

obligations.text: If virtual testing is performed by the manufacturer, the Type Approval Authority shall evaluate the declared results provided by the manufacturer, in particular pertaining to safety metrics and the coverage of the system boundaries.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o487 (Annex 3 / 4.2.1), same actor and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 4.3: TAA shall check scenarios critical for HMI characterization and verify driver disengagement monitoring and warning performance

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall check a number of scenarios that are critical for the characterization of HMI functions of the system, as well as verify the effective performance of the driver disengagement monitoring and warning system.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o488 (Annex 3 / 4.3), same actor, object and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 4.4 sentence: Type Approval Authority shall also check scenarios critical for controllability of system boundaries by the driver (examples listed) as defined in the regulation

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority shall also check a number of scenarios critical for controllability of system boundaries by the driver (e.g. object difficult to detect, system reaching its system boundaries, risk of collision with another road user, system fault conditions) as defined in the regulation.
obligations.reason: Relocation of old Annex 3 / 4.4 (o489): identical actor, action and scope under the same 'Verification and test' heading; only the page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 5 first sentence: reporting of the assessment by the Type Approval Authority shall allow traceability (e.g. coded and listed document versions)
5 second sentence: example layout of assessment form in Appendix 1
coverage.exclusion_reason: Informative example only, not a mandatory requirement.

obligations.text: The reporting of the assessment by the Type Approval Authority shall be performed in such a manner that it allows traceability, e.g. versions of documents inspected are coded and listed in the assessment records.
obligations.reason: Same scoped obligation as old Annex 3 / 5 (o490): identical Type Approval Authority reporting requirement, only the page changed.

coverage.source_unit: Appendix 1 title and Test report No field
coverage.exclusion_reason: Form title and blank field; no obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 1. Identification heading
1.1 Make: blank form field
1.2 Vehicle Type: blank form field
1.3. Means of system identification on the vehicle: ..... (form field to be completed)

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 Appendix 1 assessment report Identification section, state the means of system identification on the vehicle (item 1.3).
obligations.reason: Same form field relocated from old Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 1.3 under the same Identification heading; identical scope and wording.

coverage.source_unit: 1.4. Location of that marking: ..... (form field)

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 Appendix 1 assessment report Identification section, state the location of the system identification marking on the vehicle (item 1.4).
obligations.reason: Matches old Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 1.4 with the same parent Identification and identical wording.

coverage.source_unit: 1.5. Manufacturer’s name and address: ..... (form field)

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 Appendix 1 assessment report Identification section, state the manufacturer’s name and address (item 1.5).
obligations.reason: Same form field as old Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 1.5, same parent and wording.

coverage.source_unit: 1.6. If applicable, name and address of manufacturer’s representative: ..... (form field)

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 Appendix 1 assessment report Identification section, if applicable, state the name and address of the manufacturer’s representative (item 1.6).
obligations.reason: Same as old Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 1.6, same parent and wording; Annex 1 / 4 is a different document (communication form).

coverage.source_unit: 1.7. Manufacturer’s formal documentation package: documentation reference No, date of original issue, date of latest update (form fields)

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 Appendix 1 assessment report Identification section, state the manufacturer’s formal documentation package: documentation reference No, date of original issue and date of latest update (item 1.7).
obligations.reason: Identical to old Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 1.7 with same parent and fields.

coverage.source_unit: 2. Test vehicle(s)/system(s) description (heading)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; the substantive fields are in subparagraphs, with no standalone obligation in this clause.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1. General description: ..... (form field for test vehicle/system general description)

obligations.text: The applicant shall provide a general description of the test vehicle(s)/system(s) in the Annex 3 Appendix 1 information document, section 2.1.
obligations.reason: Same scoped form field renumbered/relocated from old Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 2.1 (o501) under the same parent 'Test vehicle(s)/system(s) description'; identical wording and context.

coverage.source_unit: 2.2. Description of all control functions of the system, including control strategies (paragraph 3.2. of Annex 3)

obligations.text: The applicant shall provide a description of all the control functions of the system, including control strategies (per paragraph 3.2. of Annex 3), in the Appendix 1 information document, section 2.2.
obligations.reason: Matches old o502 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 2.2): same field, same parent and cross-reference to paragraph 3.2 of Annex 3; no substantive change.

coverage.source_unit: 2.2.1. List of input and sensed variables and their working range, including description of effect on system behaviour (paragraph 3.2.1. of Annex 3)

obligations.text: The applicant shall list the input and sensed variables and their working range, including a description of the effect of each variable on system behaviour (per paragraph 3.2.1. of Annex 3), in Appendix 1 section 2.2.1.
obligations.reason: Matches old o503 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 2.2.1): identical wording, parent context and cross-reference.

coverage.source_unit: 2.2.2. List of output variables and their range of control (paragraph 3.2.2. of Annex 3)

obligations.text: The applicant shall list the output variables and their range of control (per paragraph 3.2.2. of Annex 3) in Appendix 1 section 2.2.2.
obligations.reason: Matches old o504 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 2.2.2): same field, parent and cross-reference; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 2.2.2.1. Directly controlled: .....

obligations.text: The applicant shall state which output variables are directly controlled by the system in Appendix 1 section 2.2.2.1.
obligations.reason: Matches old o505 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 2.2.2.1): same field under same parent chain; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 2.2.2.2. Controlled via another vehicle system: .....

obligations.text: The applicant shall state which output variables are controlled via another vehicle system in Appendix 1 section 2.2.2.2.
obligations.reason: Matches old o506 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 2.2.2.2): same field under same parent chain; unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 2.3. Description System layout and schematics (paragraph 3.3. of Annex 3): form field for system layout and schematics description

obligations.text: Test vehicle(s)/system(s) description in the test report form must include the description of the system layout and schematics (paragraph 3.3. of Annex 3).
obligations.reason: Same scoped form field relocated to new page; identical wording and same parent (Appendix 1 para 2) as old o507.

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.1. Inventory of components (paragraph 3.3.1. of Annex 3)

obligations.text: The test vehicle(s)/system(s) description must include the inventory of components (paragraph 3.3.1. of Annex 3).
obligations.reason: Identical field under same parent 2.3 as old o508; only the page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.2. Functions of the units (paragraph 3.3.2. of Annex 3)

obligations.text: The test vehicle(s)/system(s) description must include the functions of the units (paragraph 3.3.2. of Annex 3).
obligations.reason: Identical field under same parent 2.3 as old o509; same paragraph number and Annex 3 reference.

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.3. Interconnections (paragraph 3.3.3. of Annex 3)

obligations.text: The test vehicle(s)/system(s) description must include the interconnections (paragraph 3.3.3. of Annex 3).
obligations.reason: Identical field under same parent 2.3 as old o510; same Annex 3 reference.

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.4. Signal flow, operating data and priorities (paragraph 3.3.4. of Annex 3)

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.5. Identification of units (hardware & software) (paragraph 3.3.5. of Annex 3)

obligations.reason: Identical field under same parent 2.3 as old o512; same Annex 3 reference.

coverage.source_unit: 3. Manufacturer’s safety concept (heading)

coverage.source_unit: 3.1 Manufacturer's declaration that system objectives will not, under non-fault conditions, prejudice safe operation of the vehicle

obligations.reason: Same scoped declaration as old o514 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 3.1), identical wording and parent context o513, same page-level position in the appendix.

coverage.source_unit: 3.2 Software (outline architecture, design methods and tools used), paragraph 3.4.2 of Annex 3

obligations.text: Provide in the test report/communication form a description of the software (outline architecture, software design methods and tools used) as per paragraph 3.4.2 of Annex 3.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o515 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 3.2), same parent o513 and same reference to Annex 3 paragraph 3.4.2.

coverage.source_unit: 3.3 Explanation of design provisions built into the system under fault conditions, paragraph 3.4.3 of Annex 3

obligations.text: Provide in the test report/communication form an explanation of the design provisions built into the system under fault conditions as per paragraph 3.4.3 of Annex 3.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4 Documented analyses of the behaviour of the system under individual fault conditions

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.1 Parameters monitored
