obligations.reason: Identical to old o518 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 3.4.1), same parents o513/o517.

coverage.source_unit: 3.4.2. Warning signals generated: ..... (documentation form field, under 3.4 fault-condition analyses)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall document, in the safety concept information document, the warning signals generated under the analysed individual fault conditions of the system (Annex 3 Appendix 1, item 3.4.2).
obligations.reason: Same form field as old o519 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 3.4.2) with identical wording and the same parent context (3.4 fault analyses, 3 safety concept); only the page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 3.5. Description of the measures in place for environmental conditions (paragraph 3.4.4.2. of Annex 3)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall describe in the safety concept information document the measures in place for environmental conditions (paragraph 3.4.4.2. of Annex 3).
obligations.reason: Matches old o520 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 3.5): identical wording, same cross-reference and same parent (3. Manufacturer's safety concept).

coverage.source_unit: 3.6. Provisions for the periodic technical inspection of the system (paragraph 3.1. of Annex 3)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall describe in the safety concept information document the provisions for the periodic technical inspection of the system (paragraph 3.1. of Annex 3).
obligations.reason: Matches old o521 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 3.6): identical wording, cross-reference and parent.

coverage.source_unit: 3.7. Description of the method by which the operational status of the system can be checked

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall describe in the safety concept information document the method by which the operational status of the system can be checked.
obligations.reason: Matches old o522 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 3.7): identical wording and same parent context.

coverage.source_unit: 4. Verification and Test (heading)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; the obligations are in sub-paragraphs such as 4.1.

coverage.source_unit: 4.1. Verification of the function of the system (paragraph 4.1.1. of Annex 3)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide in the information document the verification of the function of the system (paragraph 4.1.1. of Annex 3).
obligations.reason: Matches old o524 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 4.1): identical wording, cross-reference and parent (4. Verification and Test).

coverage.source_unit: 4.1.1. List of the selected functions and a description of the test procedures used: ..... (scope: Appendix 1 test report, verification of system function)

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 Appendix 1 test report, under verification of the function of the system, provide the list of the selected functions and a description of the test procedures used.
obligations.reason: Same scoped report entry as old o525 (Appendix 1 / 4.1.1) under the same parent 4.1 verification of function; identical wording and context, only page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 4.1.2. Test results verified according to this Annex, paragraph 4.1.1.1. Yes/No (scope: function verification results)

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 Appendix 1 test report, under verification of the function of the system, record Yes/No whether the test results were verified according to Annex 3, paragraph 4.1.1.1.
obligations.reason: Same scoped report entry as old o526 (Appendix 1 / 4.1.2) with identical text and parent 4.1; not the 4.2.3 safety concept entry.

coverage.source_unit: 4.2. Verification of the system safety concept (paragraph 4.1.2. of Annex 3):..... (scope: safety concept verification entry)

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 Appendix 1 test report, provide the information on verification of the system safety concept (Annex 3, paragraph 4.1.2.).
obligations.reason: Same scoped report entry as old o527 (Appendix 1 / 4.2) with identical wording and parent 4; renumbering is not involved, only page change.

coverage.source_unit: 4.2.1. Unit(s) tested and their function: ..... (scope: safety concept verification)

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 Appendix 1 test report, under verification of the system safety concept, state the unit(s) tested and their function.
obligations.reason: Same scoped report entry as old o528 (Appendix 1 / 4.2.1) with identical text and parent 4.2.

coverage.source_unit: 4.2.2. Simulated fault(s): ..... (scope: safety concept verification)

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 Appendix 1 test report, under verification of the system safety concept, state the simulated fault(s).
obligations.reason: Same scoped report entry as old o529 (Appendix 1 / 4.2.2) with identical text and parent 4.2.

coverage.source_unit: 4.2.3. Test results verified according to Annex 3, paragraph 4.1.2.: Yes/No. (scope: safety concept verification results)

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 Appendix 1 test report, under verification of the system safety concept, record Yes/No whether the test results were verified according to Annex 3, paragraph 4.1.2.
obligations.reason: Same scoped report entry as old o530 (Appendix 1 / 4.2.3) with identical text and parent 4.2; distinct from 4.1.2 entry o526.

coverage.source_unit: 4.3. Date of test(s): ..... (form field)

obligations.text: In the Annex 3 Appendix 1 Verification and Test section of the communication form, the date of the test(s) shall be recorded at item 4.3.
obligations.reason: Same form field as old o531 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 4.3), identical wording and the same parent section 4 Verification and Test; only the page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 4.4 declaration that the test(s) was carried out and results reported per UN Regulation No. 1XX as amended, signed and dated by the Type Approval Authority carrying out the test

obligations.text: The Type Approval Authority carrying out the test shall declare, by signature and date, that the test(s) has been carried out and the results reported in accordance with the UN Regulation (number and amendment series stated) as last amended.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o532 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 4.4) under the same parent 4 Verification and Test; same actor and declaration scope, only renumbered by page.

coverage.source_unit: 4.5. Comments: (form field)

obligations.text: The Verification and Test section of the communication form shall provide a Comments field (item 4.5) for any comments.
obligations.reason: Same form field as old o533 (Annex 3 / Appendix 1 / 4.5) with identical wording and parent section.

coverage.source_unit: Appendix 2 System design to be assessed (heading)
1. Introduction: description of Appendix as summary of system design aspects (background)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Descriptive background sentence; not an obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 1. Introduction: 'The following information shall be provided by the manufacturer for assessment.'

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide the system design information listed in this Appendix 2 to the Type Approval Authority for assessment.
obligations.reason: Identical to old o535 (Annex 3 / Appendix 2 / 1); same actor, action and object.

coverage.source_unit: 1.1. Definitions 'For the purpose of this appendix,' (heading/lead-in)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definitions lead-in with no definitions or requirement; not an obligation.

coverage.source_unit: 1.1.1 definition of “Evidence” (physical test results, simulation results, analyses with supporting data)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Definition of a term; imposes no engineering, test or compliance obligation by itself.

coverage.source_unit: 2. heading: Information related to DCAS in general
2.1. heading: Driver Interaction and HMI
2.1.1. information item: how the system ensures driver remains engaged, incl. outline of driver monitoring system and warning strategy (5.5.4.2.)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide to the Type Approval Authority, for assessment, information on how the system is designed to ensure the driver remains engaged with the driving task, including an outline of the driver monitoring system and its warning strategy (paragraph 5.5.4.2.).
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation item as old Annex 3 / Appendix 2 / 2.1.1 (o538), identical wording and same parent context (Appendix 2, 2.1 Driver Interaction and HMI); paragraph existed before.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.1.1. information item: additional strategies for driver disengagement detection and re-engagement support (5.5.4.2.7.)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide to the Type Approval Authority, for assessment, information on additional strategies for driver disengagement detection and re-engagement support (paragraph 5.5.4.2.7.).
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation item as old Annex 3 / Appendix 2 / 2.1.1.1 (o539), identical wording and parent context; paragraph existed before.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.1.2. information item: evidence of effectiveness of driver disengagement monitoring and warning strategy

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide to the Type Approval Authority, for assessment, evidence of the effectiveness of the driver disengagement monitoring and warning strategy.
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation item as old Annex 3 / Appendix 2 / 2.1.1.2 (o540), identical wording and parent context; paragraph existed before.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.1.3 main sentence: evidence of robustness of driver disengagement monitoring across human characteristics and apparel, system performance not adversely affected
(a)-(i) list of example factors (skin complexion, gender, age, stature, facial hair, corrective glasses, sunglasses ≥70%, sunglasses <15%, varying lux)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Examples forming the scope of the single evidence obligation; covered in obligation 0 and not separate obligations.

obligations.text: The information package shall include evidence of robustness of the driver disengagement monitoring accounting for differences in human characteristics and apparel, i.e. evidence that system performance in meeting the regulatory requirements is not adversely affected by e.g. skin complexion, gender, age, stature of the driver, facial hair, corrective glasses, sunglasses with transmittance ≥ 70%, sunglasses with transmittance < 15%, and varying lux conditions.
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation obligation as o541 (same paragraph number 2.1.1.3, same Annex 3 Appendix 2 context, same list a-i); only renumbered page and a typo fix ('Varrying') differ.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.1.4 outline of driving task relevant areas, limits and applicable values for determining driver visual disengagement (para 5.5.4.2.5.2)

obligations.text: The information package shall include an outline of the driving task relevant areas, their limits, and applicable values in the context of determining the driver's visual disengagement in relation to the system and its features (paragraph 5.5.4.2.5.2.).
obligations.reason: Identical scope and wording to o542 (same paragraph 2.1.1.4, same appendix context); no substantive change.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.1.5 strategies to disable system activation upon repeated driver disengagement leading to more than one driver unavailability response (para 5.5.4.2.8.1)

obligations.text: The information package shall include the strategies to disable activation of the system in the context of repeated driver disengagement leading to more than one driver unavailability response (paragraph 5.5.4.2.8.1.).
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation item as o543 (same paragraph 2.1.1.5 and context); unchanged.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.1.6 how system addresses detection and response to multiple subsequent short aversions of eye gaze or head posture (para 5.5.4.2.5.3)

obligations.text: The information package shall describe how the system addresses the detection and response to multiple subsequent short aversions of eye gaze or head posture by the driver (paragraph 5.5.4.2.5.3.).
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation item as o544 (same paragraph 2.1.1.6 and context); unchanged wording.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.1.7 strategies for determining no deviation in eye gaze/head position for a significant period, where an EOR shall be issued (para 5.5.4.2.6.5.5)

obligations.text: The information package shall include the strategies implemented for determining when there has been no deviation in eye gaze (or movement of head position when used to determine visual engagement) for a significant period of time, where an EOR shall be issued (paragraph 5.5.4.2.6.5.5.).
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation item as o545 (same paragraph 2.1.1.7 and context); unchanged wording.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.1.8 number of repeated EOR or HOR warnings due to driver disengagement and time interval over which counted (para 5.5.4.2.8.3)

obligations.text: The information package shall state the number of repeated EOR or HOR warnings due to driver disengagement and the time interval over which these are counted (paragraph 5.5.4.2.8.3.).
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation item as o546 (same paragraph 2.1.1.8 and context); unchanged wording.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.1.9 documentation of strategies for determining whether the driver is in an appropriate position to operate the vehicle controls, with HOR issued after 10 s not in appropriate position (5.5.4.2.6.5.7.)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the information document, the strategies implemented to determine whether the driver is in an appropriate position to operate the vehicle controls, where an HOR shall be issued after the driver has not been in an appropriate position for 10 seconds (paragraph 5.5.4.2.6.5.7.).
obligations.reason: New paragraph 2.1.1.9. The old candidates (o545 for the EOR strategy on no gaze deviation, o265 and o269 for the HOR/EOR timing requirements) cover different strategies or different requirements. None is the same documentation item for the appropriate-position HOR.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.1.10 documentation of strategies to assess behaviours indicating whether the driver is consistently engaged with the driving task (5.5.4.2.7.2.)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the information document, the strategies to assess behaviours that can indicate whether or not the driver is consistently engaged with the driving task (paragraph 5.5.4.2.7.2.).
obligations.reason: New paragraph. The candidates o538, o069 and o546 are general engagement design information, the general design requirement, and repeated-warning counts. None is the documentation of consistent-engagement behaviour assessment strategies.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.2 documentation of measures against reasonably foreseeable misuse and tampering (5.1.3.)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the information document, the measures taken to guard against reasonably foreseeable misuse by the driver and tampering of the system (paragraph 5.1.3.).
obligations.reason: Identical scope and wording to old clause o547 (2.1.2) with a similarity of 1.0. The paragraph existed before.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.3 documentation of measures to encourage the driver's understanding of system limitations and continued role (5.1.2)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the information document, the measures taken to encourage the driver's understanding of the system's limitations and their continued role in the driving task (paragraph 5.1.2).
obligations.reason: Identical to old clause o548 (2.1.3) with a similarity of 1.0. The paragraph existed before.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.4 model of the information provided to users (5.6.)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the information document, a model of the information provided to users (paragraph 5.6.).
obligations.reason: Identical to old clause o549 (2.1.4) with a similarity of 1.0. The paragraph existed before.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.5 extract of the relevant part of the owner's manual

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the information document, an extract of the relevant part of the owner's manual.
obligations.reason: Identical to old clause o550 (2.1.5) with a similarity of 1.0. The paragraph existed before.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.6 list of system messages and signals (para 5.5.4.1.4)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the information document, a list of system messages and signals (paragraph 5.5.4.1.4.).
obligations.reason: Same documentation item as old o551 (Annex 3 App 2 2.1.6, same wording, same parent 2.1 Driver Interaction and HMI); renumbering not involved, only page shift.

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.7 timings and strategy to inform driver about driver-confirmed manoeuvre(s) (5.5.4.1.8.1)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide information on the timings and strategy to inform the driver about a (series of) driver-confirmed manoeuvre(s) (paragraph 5.5.4.1.8.1.).
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation item as old o552 (2.1.7, identical wording and parent context).

coverage.source_unit: 2.1.8 timings and strategy to inform driver about system-initiated manoeuvre(s) (5.5.4.1.9.1)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide information on the timings and strategy to inform the driver about a (series of) system-initiated manoeuvre(s) (paragraph 5.5.4.1.9.1.).
obligations.reason: Same scoped documentation item as old o553 (2.1.8, identical wording and parent context).

coverage.source_unit: 2.2 System Boundaries (heading)
2.2.1 system's ability to assess and respond to surroundings (5.3.2, 5.3.5)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide information on the system's ability to assess and respond to its surroundings as required to implement the intended functionality (paragraphs 5.3.2. and 5.3.5.).
obligations.reason: Same documentation item as old o555 (2.2.1, identical wording and parent 2.2 System Boundaries).

coverage.source_unit: 2.2.1.1 boundary conditions of system and features, and strategy to notify driver when exceeded, met or approached (5.3.2)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide information on the boundary conditions of the system and its features, and the strategy to notify the driver when those boundaries are exceeded, being met or approached (paragraph 5.3.2.).
obligations.reason: Same documentation item as old o556 (2.2.1.1, identical wording and parent context).

coverage.source_unit: 2.2.1.2 – information item on the system's ability to maintain appropriate distances from other road users (para 5.3.2.3), under System Boundaries

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the DCAS information document, information on the system's ability to maintain appropriate distances from other road users (paragraph 5.3.2.3.), as part of the System Boundaries information on the system's ability to assess and respond to its surroundings.
obligations.reason: Relocated/renumbered content of old o557 (Annex 3 / Appendix 2 / 2.2.1.2); identical paragraph number, parent chain (2 > 2.2 > 2.2.1) and reference to 5.3.2.3, so same scoped obligation without substantive change.

coverage.source_unit: 2.2.1.3 – information item on safety, behaviour and impact on performance when a feature remains active beyond system boundaries (para 5.3.5.2.2)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the DCAS information document, information on the system's ability to ensure safety, its behaviour and the impact on system performance when a feature remains in 'active' mode beyond the system boundaries (paragraph 5.3.5.2.2.).
obligations.reason: Same scoped information item as old o558 (Annex 3 / Appendix 2 / 2.2.1.3), same parent chain and reference to 5.3.5.2.2; no substantive change.

coverage.source_unit: 2.2.2 – information item on boundaries for detection capabilities of system and individual features (para 5.3.1)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the DCAS information document, information on the boundaries for detection capabilities for the system and individual features (paragraph 5.3.1.).
obligations.reason: Same as old o559 (Annex 3 / Appendix 2 / 2.2.2); identical text, paragraph number and parent context.

coverage.source_unit: 2.2.3 – evidence of continued safe operation when system is unable to detect a declared system boundary (para 5.3.5.4)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide evidence of continued safe operation of the system or its features when the system is unable to detect a declared system boundary (paragraph 5.3.5.4.).
obligations.reason: Same as old o560 (Annex 3 / Appendix 2 / 2.2.3); identical text, paragraph number and parent context.

coverage.source_unit: 2.2.4 – information on boundary conditions under which HORs can be withheld (para 5.5.4.2.6.5)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the DCAS information document, the boundary conditions under which Hands On Requests (HORs) can be withheld (paragraph 5.5.4.2.6.5.).
obligations.reason: Same as old o561 (Annex 3 / Appendix 2 / 2.2.4); identical text, paragraph number and parent context.

coverage.source_unit: 2.3 System operation – heading only
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; imposes no obligation itself. Specific requirements are in sub-paragraphs.

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.1. documentation of if/how the system adapts its behaviour to respond to identified safety risk of a collision (para 5.3.2.2.)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide information in the DCAS documentation (Annex 3 Appendix 2, 2.3.1) on if/how the system adapts its behaviour to respond to an identified safety risk of a collision (paragraph 5.3.2.2.).
obligations.reason: Same paragraph number and identical wording as old o563 (Annex 3 / Appendix 2 / 2.3.1), same scope in the system operation information list; renumbering of the page only.

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.2. additional preconditions for DCAS activation (para 5.5.3.2.3.)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide information in the DCAS documentation (Annex 3 Appendix 2, 2.3.2) on additional preconditions for DCAS activation (paragraph 5.5.3.2.3.).
obligations.reason: Replaces o564 (same paragraph 2.3.2, same subject: additional activation preconditions); the cross-reference changed from 5.5.3.2.2 to 5.5.3.2.3.

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.3. the system's controllability design (paras 5.3.4 and 5.3.6.)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide information in the DCAS documentation (Annex 3 Appendix 2, 2.3.3) on the system's controllability design (paragraphs 5.3.4 and 5.3.6.).
obligations.reason: Identical to o565 (same paragraph, wording, cross-references and parent context).

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.3.1. strategies ensuring controllability when the system no longer provides longitudinal or lateral assistance in response to driver override (para 5.5.3.4.1.5.)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide information in the DCAS documentation (Annex 3 Appendix 2, 2.3.3.1) on strategies ensuring controllability when the system no longer provides longitudinal or lateral assistance in response to driver override (paragraph 5.5.3.4.1.5.).
obligations.reason: Identical to o566 (same paragraph, wording and parent 2.3.3).

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.4. description of transitions between DCAS and other assistance/automation systems, prioritization, and suppression/deactivation of other systems (para 5.2.2.)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide in the DCAS documentation (Annex 3 Appendix 2, 2.3.4) a description of any transitions between DCAS and other assistance or automation systems, their prioritization of one over the other, and any suppression or deactivation of other assistance systems to ensure safe and nominal operation (paragraph 5.2.2.).
obligations.reason: Identical to o567 (same paragraph, wording and scope).

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.5. system behaviour in response to changes in system-determined road speed limits in cases other than addressed in 5.3.7.4. (para 5.3.7.4.7.3.4.)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide information in the DCAS documentation (Annex 3 Appendix 2, 2.3.5) on system behaviour in response to changes in system-determined road speed limits in cases other than those addressed in 5.3.7.4. (paragraph 5.3.7.4.7.3.4.).
obligations.reason: Identical to o568 (same paragraph, wording and scope).

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.6 – information on technically reasonable tolerances to warning thresholds and operational limits (para 5.3.7.4.10)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the DCAS information document, the technically reasonable tolerances applied to warning thresholds and operational limits (paragraph 5.3.7.4.10).
obligations.reason: Same scoped information item as old Annex 3 Appendix 2 2.3.6 (o569), identical wording and same parent section 2.3 System operation; only relocated to a new page.

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.7 – outline of the system's ability to provide continued assistance after a failure disabling a feature (para 5.4.4)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the DCAS information document, an outline of the system's ability to provide continued assistance in the case of a failure disabling a given feature (paragraph 5.4.4).
obligations.reason: Same scoped information item as old 2.3.7 (o570), identical wording and parent section; only the page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 2.3.8 – how controllability is ensured when HORs are withheld and when boundary conditions requiring an HOR are detected less than 5 s in advance (para 5.5.4.2.6.5.1)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the DCAS information document, a description of how controllability is ensured in situations where HORs are withheld, and in cases when upcoming boundary conditions requiring an HOR are detected less than 5 seconds in advance (paragraph 5.5.4.2.6.5.1).
obligations.reason: Same scoped information item as old 2.3.8 (o571), identical wording and same parent section; only the page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 3 – heading 'Information related to System Dynamic Control'
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; it imposes no obligation itself.

coverage.source_unit: 3.1 – strategy by which the system determines appropriate speed and resulting lateral acceleration in lane positioning (para 5.3.7.1.3)

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide, in the DCAS information document, the strategy by which the system determines appropriate speed and resulting lateral acceleration in the context of lane of travel positioning (paragraph 5.3.7.1.3).
obligations.reason: Same scoped information item as old 3.1 (o573), identical wording and same parent section 3; only the page changed.

coverage.source_unit: 4 – heading 'Information related to DCAS features (Where applicable)'
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; it imposes no obligation itself.

coverage.source_unit: 4.1 Strategies to ensure controllability if the system induces higher lateral acceleration values and conditions no longer met (para 6.1.1.2)

obligations.text: Where applicable to DCAS features, the manufacturer shall provide information on strategies to ensure controllability if the system induces higher lateral acceleration values and the conditions are no longer met (paragraph 6.1.1.2).
obligations.reason: Same paragraph 4.1 of Annex 3 Appendix 2 retained with identical wording and scope (only page changed); matches o575.

coverage.source_unit: 4.2 Other sources of information to determine lane positioning without lane markings (para 6.1.4.1)

obligations.text: Where applicable to DCAS features, the manufacturer shall provide information on other sources of information used to determine lane positioning without lane markings (paragraph 6.1.4.1).
obligations.reason: Identical paragraph 4.2 retained with same scope; matches o576.

coverage.source_unit: 4.3 Evidence that lane change only started if target-lane vehicle not forced to unmanageably decelerate (para 6.2.5)

obligations.text: Where applicable to DCAS features, the manufacturer shall provide evidence that a lane change manoeuvre is only started if a vehicle in the target lane is not forced to unmanageably decelerate due to the lane change (paragraph 6.2.5).
obligations.reason: Identical paragraph 4.3 retained with same documentation scope; matches o577 (not the technical requirement o306).

coverage.source_unit: 4.4 Outline of strategies ensuring lane change only into or via a lane not designated for oncoming traffic (para 6.2.9.3)

obligations.text: Where applicable to DCAS features, the manufacturer shall provide an outline of the strategies to ensure that the lane change procedure is only performed into or via a lane where the target lane is not designated for oncoming traffic (paragraph 6.2.9.3).
obligations.reason: Identical paragraph 4.4 retained with same scope; matches o578.

coverage.source_unit: 4.5 If system can navigate around obstruction in lane, evidence of other reasons for manoeuvre (para 6.3.9.1)

obligations.text: Where applicable to DCAS features, if the system can navigate around an obstruction in the lane of travel, the manufacturer shall provide sufficient evidence of other reasons to perform this manoeuvre (paragraph 6.3.9.1).
obligations.reason: Identical paragraph 4.5 retained with same conditions; matches o579.

coverage.source_unit: 5 Heading: Additional aspects to be assessed for systems capable of performing system-initiated manoeuvres
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; no standalone obligation or content in this clause.

coverage.source_unit: 5.1. heading 'Evidence of Sufficient System Performance'
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; substantive obligations are in 5.1.1-5.1.3.

coverage.source_unit: 5.1.1 manufacturer shall provide evidence of system's ability to recognize/interpret surroundings (systems capable of system-initiated manoeuvres)

obligations.text: For systems capable of performing system-initiated manoeuvres, the manufacturer shall provide evidence of the system's ability to recognize/interpret its surroundings, as evidence of sufficient system performance.
obligations.reason: New documentation/evidence obligation specific to system-initiated manoeuvres. Candidates o340 (monitoring of safety-critical occurrences), o555 (system boundaries description) and o639 (driver-initiated lane change test) differ in actor, object and scope, so no equivalence is established.

coverage.source_unit: 5.1.2 evidence shall include a set of system-capability relevant driving scenarios, environmental conditions and a variety of relevant traffic participants

obligations.text: The manufacturer's evidence of sufficient system performance for systems capable of system-initiated manoeuvres shall include a set of system-capability relevant driving scenarios, environmental conditions and a variety of different types of relevant traffic participants.
obligations.reason: New content requirement for the evidence in Annex 3 Appendix 2 para 5.1 for system-initiated manoeuvres. The Annex 4 base tests (o670, o733, o664) are type-approval test scenarios, not manufacturer evidence content, so there is no continuity.

coverage.source_unit: 5.1.3 manufacturer shall explain if and how the system's understanding of the situation and driver engagement influences execution of manoeuvres

obligations.text: For systems capable of system-initiated manoeuvres, the manufacturer shall explain if and how the system's understanding of the situation and driver engagement influences the execution of manoeuvres.
obligations.reason: New explanation obligation for system-initiated manoeuvres. Candidates o226 (HMI messages), o071 (misuse safeguards) and o716 (test tolerances) have different actor, object and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 5.2 heading 'Evidence of controllability'
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; the obligation is in 5.2.1.

coverage.source_unit: 5.2.1 manufacturer shall provide evidence of driver's ability to control system operation (systems with system-initiated manoeuvres)

obligations.text: For systems capable of performing system-initiated manoeuvres, the manufacturer shall provide evidence of the driver's ability to control system operation.
obligations.reason: New controllability evidence obligation scoped to system-initiated manoeuvres in Annex 3 Appendix 2. Candidates o340, o639 and o227 differ in object and scope, so no positive evidence of relocation or replacement exists.

coverage.source_unit: 5.2.2 lead-in 'This shall include situations where' with bullet 1: driver cancelling a manoeuvre before it is started (controllability evidence)
5.2.2 bullet 2: driver aborting an ongoing manoeuvre (controllability evidence)

obligations.text: For systems capable of performing system-initiated manoeuvres, the evidence of controllability shall include situations where the driver is cancelling a manoeuvre before it is started.
obligations.reason: New scoped controllability-evidence obligation in Annex 3 Appendix 2. Old candidates o136 and o113 concern the system not initiating a manoeuvre after an EOR or warning, and o247 concerns HOR confirmation. None covers evidence of controllability for driver cancellation, so there is no continuity of scope.

obligations.text: For systems capable of performing system-initiated manoeuvres, the evidence of controllability shall include situations where the driver is aborting an ongoing manoeuvre.
obligations.reason: Separate operating case (abort of an ongoing manoeuvre) within the controllability evidence. No old clause establishes this evidence requirement, and the candidates differ in actor, action and scope.

coverage.source_unit: 5.3 heading 'System validation'
coverage.exclusion_reason: Heading only; the requirements are in subparagraphs 5.3.1 and 5.3.2.

coverage.source_unit: 5.3.1 manufacturer shall provide evidence of system validation, including overall validation strategy and results of its execution

obligations.text: For systems capable of performing system-initiated manoeuvres, the manufacturer shall provide evidence of its system validation, including the overall validation strategy and the results of its execution.
obligations.reason: New documentation and evidence obligation for system validation under Annex 3 Appendix 2. Candidates o160, o716 and o102 are functional or test-tolerance requirements, and o821 (the Annex 5 simulation validation heading) is not the same scoped obligation. No positive evidence of equivalence.

coverage.source_unit: 5.3.2 validation evidence shall include at least relevant real world driving test results

obligations.text: The system validation evidence provided by the manufacturer for systems capable of performing system-initiated manoeuvres shall include at least relevant real world driving test results.
obligations.reason: New content requirement for the validation evidence. Candidates o089, o109 and o201 concern boundary-condition descriptions, manoeuvres and activation, so they differ in object and scope.

coverage.source_unit: Appendix 3 sentence 1: manufacturer shall explain detection capabilities of DCAS, differentiated by features if applicable, and the system boundaries for these detection capabilities
Appendix 3 list of possibly relevant objects and events (guidance)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Guidance list ('shall be taken as guidance'), not a separate mandatory obligation; it only informs the explanation obligation.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall explain the detection capabilities of DCAS, differentiated by features if applicable, and the system boundaries for these detection capabilities, taking the listed objects and events (road, road facilities, road events, environmental conditions, other road users) as guidance.
obligations.reason: Identical text to old Appendix 3 (o580), with the same actor, action and scope. Only the page changed (47 to 52).

coverage.source_unit: Appendix 4 para 1: manufacturer shall declare capability of system and features per paragraph 6 classification; declaration is reference for Annex 4 base tests
Appendix 4 para 2 sentence 1: system considered to possess declared capability if it demonstrates required behaviour in at least 90% of corresponding tests
Appendix 4 para 2 sentence 2: evidence of capability provided to Type Approval Authority via appropriate documentation
Appendix 4 para 3: when conditions deviate from test conditions, system shall not unreasonably switch control strategy, demonstrated by manufacturer per Annex 4

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall declare the capability of the system and its features according to the classification of paragraph 6, based on the Appendix 4 criteria; this declaration serves as the reference for the base tests to be performed according to Annex 4.
obligations.reason: Same wording and scope as old Appendix 4 (o581); the same actor and declaration obligation, with no substantive change.

obligations.text: The system shall be considered to possess a declared capability only if it is able to demonstrate the required behaviour in at least 90% of the corresponding tests.
obligations.reason: Same 90% pass criterion as in old Appendix 4 (o581), with unchanged scope.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall provide evidence of the declared capability to the Type Approval Authority via appropriate documentation.
obligations.reason: Same evidence-by-documentation obligation as in old Appendix 4 (o581).

obligations.text: When conditions deviate from those specified for the corresponding test, the system shall not unreasonably switch its control strategy; the manufacturer shall demonstrate this to the Type Approval Authority in accordance with Annex 4.
obligations.reason: Same requirement and demonstration obligation as in old Appendix 4 (o581), with unchanged scope.

Scenario table: Stationary vehicle ahead on curved road (4.2.5.2.2.1), Highway

obligations.reason: Same declaration obligation as old o582 (same paragraph, same actor/scope).

obligations.text: Manufacturer shall declare, for scenario 'Stationary vehicle ahead on a straight section of road' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.1.1, Highway), the max operational speed up to which the system avoids a collision with deceleration demand not exceeding 5 m/s² and the max speed for collisions requiring deceleration exceeding 5 m/s².
obligations.reason: Same scenario row in o582.

obligations.text: Manufacturer shall declare, for scenario 'Stationary vehicle ahead on a curved section of road' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.2.1, Highway), the max operational speed for avoiding a collision with deceleration demand not exceeding 5 m/s² and exceeding 5 m/s².
obligations.reason: Same scenario row in o582.

obligations.text: Manufacturer shall declare, for scenario 'Slower moving vehicle ahead on straight section of road' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.3.1, Highway), the max operational speed for avoiding a collision with deceleration demand not exceeding 5 m/s² and exceeding 5 m/s².
obligations.reason: Same scenario row in o582.

obligations.text: Manufacturer shall declare, for scenario 'Cut-out of lead vehicle' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.5.1, Highway), the max operational speed for avoiding a collision with deceleration demand not exceeding 5 m/s² and exceeding 5 m/s².
obligations.reason: Same scenario row in o582.

obligations.text: Manufacturer shall declare (Yes/No) whether a system response can be expected for scenario 'Cut-in vehicle from adjacent lane – Type 1' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.6.1, Highway), for deceleration demand not exceeding and exceeding 5 m/s².
obligations.reason: Same scenario row in o582.

obligations.text: Manufacturer shall declare (Yes/No) whether a system response can be expected for scenario 'Cut-in vehicle from adjacent lane – Type 2' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.6.1, Highway), for deceleration demand not exceeding and exceeding 5 m/s².
obligations.reason: Same scenario row in o582.

obligations.reason: Same scenario row as o583.

obligations.text: Manufacturer shall declare, for 'Stationary bicycle ahead in lane' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.8.1, Non-Highway), the max operational speed for avoiding a collision with deceleration demand not exceeding 5 m/s² and exceeding 5 m/s².
obligations.reason: Same scenario row as o583.

obligations.reason: Same scenario row as o583.

obligations.text: Manufacturer shall declare, for 'Pedestrian target crossing into the path of the VUT' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.9.1, Non-Highway), the max operational speed for avoiding a collision with deceleration demand not exceeding 5 m/s² and exceeding 5 m/s².
obligations.reason: Same scenario row as o583.

obligations.text: Manufacturer shall declare, for 'Bicycle target crossing into the path of the VUT' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.10.1, Non-Highway), the max operational speed for avoiding a collision with deceleration demand not exceeding 5 m/s² and exceeding 5 m/s².

obligations.text: Manufacturer shall complete the additional scenario row(s) with the max operational speed for avoiding a collision at deceleration demand not exceeding 5 m/s² and exceeding 5 m/s², with operating domain.
obligations.reason: Same manufacturer-completed row in o583.

obligations.text: Manufacturer shall declare the system's capability to follow the course of the lane: speed range(s), minimum lateral acceleration, maximum lateral acceleration and specific conditions (e.g., paragraph 6.1.1).
obligations.reason: Same par. 2 table as in o583.

coverage.source_unit: Par. 2.1 intro: manufacturer to complete road attributes table, extendable, or indicate Not Applicable

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall complete, and may extend, the table of road attributes the system may recognize relevant to the declared system boundaries and design (toll station, end of highway, permanent/temporary lane ending, long-term construction zone, railway crossings, intersections, roundabouts, pedestrian crossing, stop sign, give-way sign, traffic lights), stating for each whether it is a system boundary and whether the system will not respond, will respond upon detection or will provide an early warning, with operating domain; or indicate 'Not Applicable'.
obligations.reason: Same declaration table as o584 with identical scope.

coverage.source_unit: Par. 3: declare range at which system responds to other unobstructed targets if equipped with lane change feature (rear/front/side, motorcycle)
Par. 3: declare conditions under which the maximum range is reduced
Table rows: blocked target lane and types of obstacles (Not applicable for rear/side)
coverage.exclusion_reason: Table rows with prefilled Not applicable/manufacturer completion; covered by declaration obligation

obligations.text: If equipped with a lane change feature (driver- or system-initiated), the manufacturer shall declare the range (rear, front, side, in m) at which the system is able to respond to other unobstructed targets, e.g. a motorcycle.
obligations.reason: Same as o585 declaration.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall declare the conditions under which the maximum range at which the system responds to other unobstructed targets (lane change feature) is reduced.
obligations.reason: Same as o585 conditions declaration.

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall indicate the system's ability to safely perform other system-initiated manoeuvres or to respond to targets in non-highway environments without driver intervention, or indicate 'Not Applicable'.
obligations.reason: Replaces o586 general declaration; 'driver-initiated or' removed so limited to system-initiated manoeuvres.

obligations.text: Where declared (not 'Not Applicable'), the manufacturer shall state whether the system will be able to avoid a collision and the preconditions, for scenario 'Pedestrian target crossing into the path of the VUT in an intersection' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.11.1), without driver intervention in non-highway environments.
obligations.reason: Same row as o586.

obligations.text: Where declared (not 'Not Applicable'), the manufacturer shall state whether the system will be able to avoid a collision and the preconditions, for scenario 'Bicycle target crossing into the path of the VUT in an intersection' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.12.1), without driver intervention.
obligations.reason: Same row as o586.

obligations.text: Where declared (not 'Not Applicable'), the manufacturer shall state whether the system will be able to avoid a collision and the preconditions, for scenario 'VUT turns across a path of an oncoming vehicle' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.13.1), without driver intervention.
obligations.reason: Same row as o586.

obligations.text: Where declared (not 'Not Applicable'), the manufacturer shall state whether the system will be able to avoid a collision and the preconditions, for scenario 'VUT crosses the straight path of a vehicle target in an intersection' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.14.1), without driver intervention.
obligations.reason: Same row as o586.

obligations.text: Where declared (not 'Not Applicable'), the manufacturer shall state whether the system will be able to avoid a collision and the preconditions, for scenario 'System-initiated manoeuvring around an obstruction in the lane' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.15), without driver intervention.
obligations.reason: Same row as o586.

obligations.text: Where declared (not 'Not Applicable'), the manufacturer shall state whether the system will be able to avoid a collision and the preconditions, for scenario 'Longitudinally moving bicycle target ahead in lane' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.16), without driver intervention.
obligations.reason: Scenario row not present in old o586.

obligations.text: Where declared (not 'Not Applicable'), the manufacturer shall state whether the system will be able to avoid a collision and the preconditions, for scenario 'Cut-out of lead vehicle with an interfering vehicle' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.17), without driver intervention.
obligations.reason: Scenario row not present in old o586.

obligations.text: Where declared (not 'Not Applicable'), the manufacturer shall state whether the system will be able to avoid a collision and the preconditions, for scenario 'Pedestrian target crossing into the path of the VUT during drive around manoeuvre' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.18), without driver intervention.
obligations.reason: Scenario row not present in old o586.

obligations.text: Where declared (not 'Not Applicable'), the manufacturer shall state whether the system will be able to avoid a collision and the preconditions, for scenario 'VUT crosses the straight path of the vehicle target in a partially obstructed intersection' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.19), without driver intervention.
obligations.reason: Scenario row not present in old o586.

obligations.text: Where declared (not 'Not Applicable'), the manufacturer shall state whether the system will be able to avoid a collision and the preconditions, for scenario 'VUT turns across a path of an oncoming vehicle and cyclist' (Annex 4, par. 4.2.5.2.20), without driver intervention.
obligations.reason: Scenario row not present in old o586.

coverage.source_unit: Par. 5: manufacturer shall declare traffic rule compliance related to a certain manoeuvre, if relevant to the given signal, incl. table of rules such as duration of indication of Lane Change Procedure
Par. 5: permission to additionally specify country-specific performance

obligations.text: The manufacturer shall declare traffic rule compliance related to a certain driver-initiated manoeuvre, if relevant to the given signal, stating for each potentially relevant rule (e.g. duration of indication of the Lane Change Procedure) whether the system is designed to obey it.
obligations.reason: Same declaration as o587; only hyphen formatting differs.

obligations.text: Where the system's performance in traffic rule compliance is specific to a country of operation, the manufacturer may additionally specify this.
obligations.reason: Same permission as o587.

coverage.source_unit: Annex 4 heading: Physical Test Specifications for DCAS Validation
Intro para 1, sentence 1: Annex defines physical tests to verify technical requirements and manufacturer declaration
coverage.exclusion_reason: Descriptive statement of purpose; no independent obligation.

coverage.source_unit: Intro para 1, sentence 2: all relevant base tests shall be performed or witnessed by the TAA
Para 2, sentence 1: at least one extended test per applicable base test performed or witnessed during approval
Para 2, sentence 2: further extended tests at TAA request
Para 2, sentence 3: manufacturer provides evidence for extended tests not performed
Para 3, sentence 1: TAA may identify scenarios of particular safety relevance
Para 3, sentence 2: identified scenario may replace a base or extended test only if manufacturer provides satisfactory evidence
Para 3, sentence 3: rationale and scenario description documented in test report
Para 4: track test parameters selected by TAA and recorded in test report
Para 5: pass/fail criteria derived solely from paras 5 and 6 and declarations
Para 6: tests are a minimum set; TAA may perform additional tests

obligations.text: All relevant base tests in Annex 4 shall be performed or witnessed by the Type Approval Authority or the Technical Service acting on its behalf during the approval process.
obligations.reason: Old o589 required all tests in the annex to be performed or witnessed; new text limits this to relevant base tests, a changed replacement of the same obligation.

obligations.text: At least one extended test associated with each applicable base test shall be performed or witnessed during the approval process.
obligations.reason: Extended tests are introduced in the new version; no equivalent in o589.

obligations.text: Further extended tests shall be performed or witnessed during the approval process at the request of the Type Approval Authority.
obligations.reason: New extended-test request provision.

obligations.text: For extended tests not performed during the approval process, the manufacturer shall provide evidence of the required system behaviour in those scenarios.
obligations.reason: New manufacturer evidence obligation for extended tests not performed.

obligations.text: During the assessment according to Annex 3, the Type Approval Authority may identify scenarios of particular relevance with regard to safety risk.
obligations.reason: New permission for the TAA to identify safety-relevant scenarios.

obligations.text: An identified scenario with particular safety relevance may replace a base or extended test scenario only if the manufacturer provides satisfactory evidence of test performance of the replaced scenario.
obligations.reason: New conditional replacement permission.

obligations.text: The rationale for replacing a base or extended test and a detailed description of the identified scenario applied shall be documented in the test report.
obligations.reason: New documentation obligation tied to scenario replacement.

obligations.text: The specific test parameters for track tests shall be selected by the Type Approval Authority based on the manufacturer's declaration and recorded in the test report so as to allow traceability and repeatability of the test setup.
obligations.reason: Same obligation as in o589 (same actor, track test parameters, recording in test report) without substantive change.

obligations.text: Pass and fail criteria for tests shall be derived solely from the technical requirements in paragraphs 5 and 6 of this UN Regulation and correspondence with the declarations made according to Appendix 4 to Annex 3.
obligations.reason: Matches o589 pass/fail criteria sentence unchanged.

obligations.text: The tests specified in Annex 4 are a minimum set of tests; the Type Approval Authority may perform additional tests and compare measured results against the requirements in paragraphs 5 and 6 or the contents of the Audit according to Annex 3.
obligations.reason: Matches o589 minimum-set and additional-tests sentence unchanged.
